people.name: George A. Romero
people.bio: Pittsburgh filmmaker whose first feature, made with friends on a shoestring, invented the modern zombie film and its social bite.

people.name: Duane Jones
people.bio: Stage actor and teacher whose casting as the resourceful Ben made quiet history in 1968.

people.name: Judith O'Dea
people.bio: Actress best remembered as Barbra, the stunned survivor at the heart of Night of the Living Dead.

people.name: F. W. Murnau
people.bio: German Expressionist director of Nosferatu, The Last Laugh and Sunrise, a master of shadow and camera movement.

people.name: Max Schreck
people.bio: Stage and screen actor whose Count Orlok remains one of cinema's most unsettling creations.

people.name: Buster Keaton
people.bio: The Great Stone Face: comedian, director and stuntman whose deadpan and daring shaped screen comedy.

people.name: Howard Hawks
people.bio: Versatile Hollywood director of screwball comedies, westerns and noirs, famous for overlapping dialogue.

people.name: Cary Grant
people.bio: Debonair leading man of Hollywood's golden age, equally at home in screwball comedy and Hitchcock suspense.

people.name: Rosalind Russell
people.bio: Quick-witted star of His Girl Friday and Auntie Mame, a four-time Academy Award nominee.

people.name: Stanley Donen
people.bio: Director of Singin' in the Rain and Charade, who brought musical grace to comedy and thrillers.

people.name: Audrey Hepburn
people.bio: Actress and humanitarian, star of Roman Holiday, Breakfast at Tiffany's and Charade.

people.name: Walter Matthau
people.bio: Rumpled, beloved character actor and comic star of The Odd Couple and Charade.

people.name: Edgar G. Ulmer
people.bio: King of the B movie, who made Detour in six days and turned poverty-row budgets into style.

people.name: Tom Neal
people.bio: Actor and boxer who played the doomed hitchhiker Al Roberts in Detour.

people.name: Ann Savage
people.bio: Her ferocious Vera in Detour is one of film noir's most memorable performances.

people.name: Herk Harvey
people.bio: Industrial filmmaker from Kansas whose only feature, Carnival of Souls, became a cult classic.

people.name: Candace Hilligoss
people.bio: Actress who starred as the haunted organist Mary Henry in Carnival of Souls.

people.name: Robert Wiene
people.bio: Director of The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari, the landmark of German Expressionist cinema.

people.name: Conrad Veidt
people.bio: Expressive star of Caligari and The Man Who Laughs, later Major Strasser in Casablanca.

people.name: Werner Krauss
people.bio: Leading German stage actor who played the sinister showman Dr. Caligari.

people.name: Charlie Chaplin
people.bio: Comedian, director and composer whose Tramp became the most recognizable figure of the silent era.

people.name: Jackie Coogan
people.bio: Hollywood's first great child star, discovered by Chaplin for The Kid.

people.name: Harold Lloyd
people.bio: Bespectacled comic everyman whose clock-hanging stunt in Safety Last! is cinema legend.

people.name: Sergei Eisenstein
people.bio: Soviet pioneer of montage theory whose Odessa Steps sequence is among the most studied in film.

people.name: Lon Chaney
people.bio: The Man of a Thousand Faces, who designed his own startling make-up for The Phantom of the Opera.

people.name: Vincent Price
people.bio: Silky-voiced icon of horror, from House of Wax to The Last Man on Earth.

people.name: Ida Lupino
people.bio: Actress turned trailblazing director; The Hitch-Hiker was the first mainstream American noir directed by a woman.

people.name: Edmond O'Brien
people.bio: Academy Award-winning actor who starred in The Hitch-Hiker and D.O.A.

people.name: Tom Graeff
people.bio: Independent filmmaker who wrote, directed, shot and edited Teenagers from Outer Space.

people.name: Sacha Goedegebure
people.bio: Dutch animator who directed Big Buck Bunny, the Blender Foundation’s second open movie.

people.name: Colin Levy
people.bio: Director of the Blender open movie Sintel, later a filmmaker and animator.

people.name: Ian Hubert
people.bio: Filmmaker and visual effects artist who directed Tears of Steel.

people.name: Bassam Kurdali
people.bio: Animator and educator who directed Elephants Dream, the first Blender open movie.

people.name: Mathieu Auvray
people.bio: French director of the Blender open movie Cosmos Laundromat.

people.name: Andy Goralczyk
people.bio: Blender Studio artist who directed the open movie Spring.

people.name: Hjalti Hjálmarsson
people.bio: Animator and director of the Blender Studio open movie Charge.

movies.title: Night of the Living Dead
movies.tagline: They keep coming back in a bloodthirsty lust for human flesh!
movies.synopsis: When the recently dead rise across rural Pennsylvania, a handful of strangers barricade themselves in a farmhouse. As the night wears on, the danger outside is matched by the fear and mistrust within.
movies.poster: File:Night Of The Living Dead (1968) - Poster.jpg

movies.title: Nosferatu
movies.synopsis: Estate agent Thomas Hutter travels to the Carpathian mountains to sell a house to the mysterious Count Orlok, who then follows him home by ship, bringing plague and terror to the town of Wisborg.

movies.title: The General
movies.synopsis: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, Southern engineer Johnnie Gray gives chase across enemy lines in one of the most daring and meticulously staged comedies ever made.

movies.title: His Girl Friday
movies.tagline: The fastest talking comedy ever made.
movies.synopsis: A hard-boiled newspaper editor learns his ex-wife and star reporter is about to remarry, and lures her back for one last story: the impending execution of a man who may be innocent.

movies.title: Charade
movies.synopsis: Back in Paris after her husband's murder, Regina Lampert is pursued by three men hunting for a fortune he stole, and by a charming stranger whose name keeps changing.

movies.title: Detour
movies.tagline: The strangest trip a man ever took!
movies.synopsis: A New York nightclub pianist hitchhikes west to reach his fiancée, but a sudden death on the road sets him on a fatalistic slide into guilt, blackmail and the grip of a merciless passenger.

movies.title: Carnival of Souls
movies.tagline: She walked out of the river... into a nightmare.
movies.synopsis: After surviving a car accident, a church organist moves to a new town, where a pale, ghostly man and the pull of an abandoned lakeside pavilion begin to consume her waking life.
movies.video: File:Carnival of Souls (1962) by Herk Harvey.webm

movies.title: The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari
movies.synopsis: In a crooked, painted town, a fairground hypnotist exhibits a somnambulist who predicts deaths, and a young man becomes convinced the showman is behind a string of murders.
movies.poster: File:The Cabinet of Doctor Caligari Movie poster.jpg

movies.title: Sherlock Jr.
movies.synopsis: A projectionist who dreams of being a detective falls asleep at work and walks straight into the film on screen, where the editing itself becomes his obstacle course.

movies.title: Safety Last!
movies.synopsis: A small-town boy trying to impress his sweetheart in the big city promises a publicity stunt, then finds himself climbing the face of a twelve-story department store himself.

movies.title: The Kid
movies.tagline: A picture with a smile, and perhaps a tear.
movies.synopsis: The Tramp finds an abandoned baby and raises him as his own, until the authorities and the child's mother, now a famous star, come looking for him.

movies.title: Battleship Potemkin
movies.tagline: The mutiny that shook an empire.
movies.synopsis: Pushed too far by their officers, the sailors of the Potemkin rise up, and the people of Odessa rally to them, until soldiers march down the harbor steps.

movies.title: The Phantom of the Opera
movies.tagline: The man of a thousand faces.
movies.synopsis: Beneath the Paris Opera House lives a masked genius who tutors a young soprano from the shadows, and who will stop at nothing to make her a star, and his.

movies.title: The Last Man on Earth
movies.synopsis: After a plague turns humanity into vampiric creatures, scientist Robert Morgan spends his days hunting them and his nights barricaded at home, until he meets a survivor who changes everything.
movies.poster: search:The Last Man on Earth 1964 poster Vincent Price
movies.video: File:The Last Man on Earth (1964) by Ubaldo Ragona and Sidney Salkow.webm

movies.title: The Hitch-Hiker
movies.tagline: Who'll be his next victim... you?
movies.synopsis: Two friends on a fishing trip pick up a hitchhiker who turns out to be a psychopathic killer, and are forced to drive him across the Mexican desert at gunpoint.

movies.title: Teenagers from Outer Space
movies.synopsis: A young alien rebels against his ruthless crew when they land in a California town to breed giant monsters, and falls for the girl who shows him kindness.
movies.video: File:Teenagers from Outer Space (1959) by Tom Graeff.webm

movies.title: Big Buck Bunny
movies.tagline: A day in the life of a gentle giant.
movies.synopsis: A giant, gentle rabbit enjoys a sunny morning in the meadow until three bullying rodents go too far, and he plans an elaborate, comic revenge.

movies.title: Elephants Dream
movies.synopsis: Old Proog guides young Emo through an endless mechanical world he claims to understand, but the Machine seems to have its own ideas about both of them.

movies.title: Sintel
movies.tagline: A lonely young woman searches for her dragon.
movies.synopsis: Sintel raises a wounded baby dragon, and when it is snatched away she crosses snowfields, deserts and cities on a relentless search that ends somewhere she never expected.

movies.title: Tears of Steel
movies.tagline: A last chance to save the world.
movies.synopsis: In a future Amsterdam overrun by robots, a group of scientists stages a desperate experiment to recreate a single moment from the past, and repair a broken heart.

movies.title: Cosmos Laundromat
movies.synopsis: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets a mysterious salesman who offers him the gift of a lifetime: many lifetimes, in fact.
movies.video: File:Cosmos Laundromat - First Cycle - Official Blender Foundation release.webm

movies.title: Spring
movies.tagline: A shepherd girl and her dog face ancient spirits.
movies.synopsis: A shepherd girl and her dog confront the ancient spirits of the mountain in order to continue the cycle of life, and bring spring back to the valley.

movies.title: Charge
movies.synopsis: In a dystopian world where energy is the ultimate currency, an old man breaks into a heavily guarded facility and is drawn into a fierce fight with a robot guard.

people.name: Amara Okoye
people.bio: She broke through as a railway union organizer in the chamber drama Winter Platform, then built a career around women who make difficult public choices.

people.name: Leila Haddad
people.bio: She began on Tunisian stages before her sharp comic turn as a hotel manager brought her into international features.

people.name: Mei Tan
people.bio: Her restrained performance as a missing cartographer in Tidal Survey made her a sought-after lead for intimate mysteries.

people.name: Sofia Alvarez
people.bio: She moved from physical comedy to tense family dramas after playing a stubborn dockworker in The Last Manifest.

people.name: Nari Choi
people.bio: She made her feature debut as a teenage archer and later became known for quietly defiant characters in urban thrillers.

people.name: Camille Moreau
people.bio: She earned early acclaim portraying a provincial magistrate and now brings dry wit to formidable mothers and mentors.

people.name: Priya Nair
people.bio: Her first leading role followed a radio host through a citywide blackout; she favors quick dialogue and emotionally guarded heroines.

people.name: Elena Varga
people.bio: She trained in classical theater, then surprised audiences with a fearless comic performance as a failed jewel thief.

people.name: Hana Mori
people.bio: She drew notice as an apprentice clockmaker in a period romance and has since taken roles that hinge on precise, silent reactions.

people.name: Lucia Ferraro
people.bio: She established herself in ensemble comedies before playing a whistleblowing council clerk in a political drama.

people.name: Zora Petrovic
people.bio: She returned to film after a decade directing theater, winning attention for a grieving astronomer who refuses to leave her observatory.

people.name: Samira Rahman
people.bio: Her breakout as a bicycle courier caught between rival campaigns revealed a gift for urgent, unsentimental performances.

people.name: Ingrid Solberg
people.bio: She became a screen fixture playing a lighthouse keeper in the 1980s and remains prized for her austere warmth.

people.name: Talia Reed
people.bio: She crossed from improv theater into features with a disastrous wedding farce, then found equal success in legal dramas.

people.name: Fatima Bako
people.bio: She first appeared as a market organizer confronting a corrupt landlord and is admired for grounded, commanding leads.

people.name: Aisha Qureshi
people.bio: She turned a small role as a night-shift dispatcher into a breakthrough, balancing nervous humor with watchful intensity.

people.name: Mara Velasquez
people.bio: She became known for restless, sharp-edged matriarchs after decades of work in Colombian regional theater.

people.name: Elise Laurent
people.bio: She won her first feature lead as a competitive swimmer hiding an injury and now gravitates toward impulsive young protagonists.

people.name: Noemi Costa
people.bio: She played a meticulous conservator in her first international feature, a role that established her flair for moral suspense.

people.name: Ada Mensah
people.bio: She gained notice portraying a rookie paramedic during a flood and has kept a taste for physically demanding parts.

people.name: Yuna Seo
people.bio: She moved from television comedy to film with a tender portrait of a translator caring for her estranged father.

people.name: Rina Sato
people.bio: She is associated with coolly observant detectives, though her early career was built on eccentric musical comedies.

people.name: Eva Lind
people.bio: She drew festival attention as a solitary ferry captain and later embraced darker roles in Scandinavian crime films.

people.name: Salma Idrissi
people.bio: She made a striking debut as a music teacher defying a school closure and favors characters with unshowy resolve.

people.name: Anika Mehta
people.bio: She broke out as a fearless junior reporter in a campus mystery and brings nimble comic timing to ensemble casts.

people.name: Clara Weiss
people.bio: She spent years with repertory companies before her late-career screen breakthrough as a retired train conductor.

people.name: Alma Ruiz
people.bio: She became a familiar face in rural dramas after portraying a village doctor whose clinic served three valleys.

people.name: Iris Bell
people.bio: She began in radio plays, then made her mark as a skeptical folklorist in an atmospheric mystery.

people.name: Nadia Karim
people.bio: She earned her first lead as a chess prodigy navigating a family business and is known for fiercely focused performances.

people.name: Eszter Nagy
people.bio: She played stage heroines for three decades before finding a new screen audience as a sly, poker-playing grandmother.

people.name: Binta Diallo
people.bio: She first drew attention as a harbor pilot negotiating a dangerous passage and now works across French and English productions.

people.name: Jo Park
people.bio: She went from regional theater to a breakout role as a runaway cellist in a road comedy.

people.name: Celeste Marin
people.bio: Her wry, precise portrayals often follow professionals whose tidy routines unravel under pressure.

people.name: Nisha Rao
people.bio: She turned to film after a long dance career, bringing unusual physical grace to roles as teachers and political rivals.

people.name: Maeve Collins
people.bio: She made her name as an irreverent baker in a small-town comedy before taking on a succession of troubled heroines.

people.name: Idris Bello
people.bio: He broke through playing an exhausted election observer and is now admired for calm performances under mounting pressure.

people.name: Karim Mansour
people.bio: He came from street theater and found screen success as a silver-tongued port official in a crime caper.

people.name: Wei Chen
people.bio: He gained attention as a patient robotics technician in a family drama and later moved into brisk action roles.

people.name: Mateo Rojas
people.bio: He spent his early career in touring theater before a vivid turn as a disgraced mayor brought him to film.

people.name: Jun Park
people.bio: He first stood out as a charming but unreliable translator in a cross-border romance.

people.name: Luc Dubois
people.bio: He built a screen career on tenderly irritable fathers after a celebrated run in experimental theater.

people.name: Arjun Sethi
people.bio: He brought a dancer's agility to his debut as a rooftop courier and later proved equally adept at subdued drama.

people.name: Tomas Kovac
people.bio: He is known for austere historical roles, especially a village engineer forced to choose between work and family.

people.name: Kenji Arai
people.bio: He began in sketch comedy but won dramatic acclaim as a father searching abandoned train stations for his son.

people.name: Marco Bellini
people.bio: He emerged as a bright comic lead in a restaurant farce before playing a calculating young barrister.

people.name: Milan Jovic
people.bio: He became known for plainspoken wartime characters and made a late return to screen comedy as a retired riverboat mechanic.

people.name: Farid Alam
people.bio: He crossed from radio drama to cinema as a sardonic shipping inspector with a talent for finding secrets.

people.name: Erik Dahl
people.bio: He made his name in coastal crime stories, often playing men whose confident stories conceal ordinary fear.

people.name: Jonah Price
people.bio: He moved from stand-up into a breakout role as a painfully earnest community-theater director.

people.name: Kwame Adu
people.bio: He drew praise as a school principal protecting students during a labor strike and favors morally complicated leads.

people.name: Bilal Shah
people.bio: He won attention playing a meticulous street photographer whose negatives expose a civic scandal.

people.name: Rafael Soto
people.bio: He became a reliable character actor through warm but evasive patriarchs, then found a late leading role in a desert western.

people.name: Olivier Marchand
people.bio: He broke through as a nervous museum guard and is known for turning awkward pauses into comic tension.

people.name: Tiago Pereira
people.bio: He trained as a classical guitarist before acting, a background that shaped his breakout role as a touring musician.

people.name: Kojo Asante
people.bio: He started in action ensembles and gained acclaim for a quiet portrayal of a young nurse returning home.

people.name: Minho Han
people.bio: He rose through romantic comedies before taking darker parts as investigators and compromised sons.

people.name: Daichi Ito
people.bio: He spent years voicing animated characters and later became a measured presence in live-action family stories.

people.name: Nils Berg
people.bio: He is best known for a seafaring trilogy and brings weathered humor to recent supporting roles.

people.name: Youssef Amrani
people.bio: He entered film as a stunt performer and found a dramatic breakthrough playing a conflicted mountain guide.

people.name: Dev Malhotra
people.bio: He made a lively feature debut as an amateur magician attempting to save his family's cinema.

people.name: Felix Bauer
people.bio: He worked as a stage illusionist before his screen breakthrough as a meticulous forger.

people.name: Diego Salazar
people.bio: He first made audiences laugh as a catastrophically unlucky chef, then shifted toward morally tangled thrillers.

people.name: Owen Blake
people.bio: He became a character-actor favorite with a laconic harbor master and has since played many stubborn eccentrics.

people.name: Sami Nasser
people.bio: He drew notice as an apprentice restorer uncovering a family deception in his first feature.

people.name: Balazs Farkas
people.bio: He built a career in historical theater and brought its patient intensity to his screen roles as judges and generals.

people.name: Mamadou Sarr
people.bio: He won early praise playing a river ferryman and now moves between intimate dramas and restless adventure films.

people.name: Jae Kim
people.bio: He made his mark as an anxious debate captain in a school comedy and quickly moved into leading roles.

people.name: Antoine Girard
people.bio: He was celebrated for irreverent 1970s police comedies and later played a succession of elegant villains.

people.name: Vikram Bhat
people.bio: He first appeared as a struggling concert promoter and grew into a versatile performer of gentle family stories.

people.name: Callum Fraser
people.bio: He found his first substantial screen role as a conservation diver with a secret fear of open water.

people.name: Ines Marceau
people.bio: She moved from documentary editing to fiction, directing spare family dramas that give silence the weight of dialogue.

people.name: Dario Conti
people.bio: He made his first feature in an abandoned railway depot and remains drawn to labor, machinery, and uneasy loyalties.

people.name: Seon Lee
people.bio: She emerged from short-form horror with carefully staged films that turn familiar apartments into traps.

people.name: Omar Elmasri
people.bio: He began filming theater rehearsals, then developed a gift for propulsive ensemble stories set in crowded cities.

people.name: Lena Brooks
people.bio: She moved from sports documentaries to features about teamwork strained by money and ambition.

people.name: Arturo Ibarra
people.bio: He established his reputation with sun-baked westerns centered on ordinary people caught in border disputes.

people.name: Hyejin Kim
people.bio: She won attention with a brisk courtroom debut and has since mixed procedural detail with family conflict.

people.name: Soren Nygaard
people.bio: He began with maritime documentaries and brings a patient eye for weather to his fictional suspense films.

people.name: Mira Desai
people.bio: A musical about rival street bands brought her early acclaim; she favors crowded frames full of movement.

people.name: Pavel Hruby
people.bio: He directed meticulous Cold War dramas and made his final film about a cartographer confronting an altered coastline.

people.name: Celia Rocha
people.bio: She learned her craft on location crews and is known for vivid comedies about stubborn neighbors.

people.name: Hiro Takeda
people.bio: He made experimental animation before directing live-action fantasies rooted in small domestic rituals.

people.name: Ayana Diop
people.bio: She began as a photojournalist and uses close observation to ground stories about migration and civic duty.

people.name: Gabriel Ortega
people.bio: He first directed mountain rescue documentaries, later bringing their physical detail to adventure features.

people.name: Noura Salem
people.bio: She crafts political mysteries around private acts of courage, often using a single building as the stage.

people.name: Ethan Cross
people.bio: He graduated from practical-effects crews to direct muscular science fiction with tactile sets.

people.name: Kavita Sharma
people.bio: She built a long career in intimate romances before turning to intergenerational stories about work and inheritance.

people.name: Matthias Vogel
people.bio: He brings a background in architectural photography to eerie films about surveillance and urban space.

people.name: Lucia Bianchi
people.bio: She made a buoyant debut about a stolen festival float and remains fond of unruly ensemble casts.

people.name: Bastien Roux
people.bio: He began in sound design, an influence audible in his thrillers about overheard conversations.

people.name: Helena Silva
people.bio: She turns archival fragments into lucid historical films and brings the same rigor to her fictional work.

people.name: Malik Johnson
people.bio: He emerged through dance films and directs kinetic dramas shaped by music and neighborhood politics.

people.name: Elsa Lund
people.bio: She has spent decades making measured domestic dramas where a small practical decision changes a family.

people.name: Julian Mercer
people.bio: He developed a following for capers that let ordinary professionals solve problems with their actual skills.

people.name: Marisol Vega
people.bio: She favors sunlit family stories with brisk dialogue and characters who rarely say what they mean first.

people.name: Rachel Adebayo
people.bio: She wrote radio serials before her first feature script, a tense account of sisters reopening a shuttered cinema.

people.name: Antonio Serra
people.bio: He specializes in stories of civic corruption, writing officials whose bargains grow steadily harder to defend.

people.name: Soojin Bae
people.bio: She developed mystery scripts after years reporting on municipal courts and is admired for precise procedural turns.

people.name: Yusuf Hamid
people.bio: He began with satirical plays about bureaucracy and carried their quick, humane dialogue into screenwriting.

people.name: Ellen Voss
people.bio: She writes resourceful young characters into tightly plotted adventures, drawing on her childhood near the Great Lakes.

people.name: Rafael Mendez
people.bio: He built his career on frontier dramas that treat water, land, and family debts as inseparable.

people.name: Pari Kapoor
people.bio: She moved from lyric writing into screenplays with a sharp musical comedy about rival wedding planners.

people.name: Mikkel Borg
people.bio: He writes chilly maritime mysteries in which official records conceal intensely personal motives.

people.name: Natsumi Endo
people.bio: Her patient family fantasies give everyday objects unexpected emotional weight.

people.name: Peter Havel
people.bio: He wrote several acclaimed historical scripts before turning to contemporary stories about memory and complicity.

people.name: Ana Paiva
people.bio: She scripts dryly funny domestic upheavals, often beginning with a practical problem nobody wants to own.

people.name: Samir Dawood
people.bio: He made his screenwriting debut with a heist organized by underpaid museum staff and has kept an ear for workplace banter.

people.name: Odette Fournier
people.bio: She writes elegant relationship dramas built around letters, missed trains, and decisions made too late.

people.name: Isaac Ward
people.bio: He favors grounded speculative stories and worked as a marine technician before his first produced script.

people.name: Luz Morales
people.bio: A comic script about an improvised neighborhood orchestra launched her career in energetic ensemble films.

people.name: Lena Hartwell
people.bio: She began in regional theater and became known for playing officials whose composure cracks under public scrutiny.

people.name: Amara Diallo
people.bio: She trained as a percussionist before moving into screen comedy, where her brisk timing made her a favorite in ensemble casts.

people.name: Elsie Ward
people.bio: She built a career around sharply observed portraits of women negotiating family loyalty and public duty.

people.name: Priya Nair
people.bio: She moved from radio drama to television and is admired for giving restless young characters a dry, guarded wit.

people.name: June Salazar
people.bio: She studied architecture before acting, a background she draws on for characters who read rooms before they speak.

people.name: Noelle Baptiste
people.bio: She spent a decade on small stages and now specializes in exacting professionals with messy private lives.

people.name: Marina Costa
people.bio: She is known for quiet performances that allow grief, suspicion and humor to occupy the same scene.

people.name: Talia Brooks
people.bio: She gained notice in youth theater for quicksilver shifts between bravado and vulnerability.

people.name: Romy Voss
people.bio: She favors physically demanding roles and trained in stage combat for a run of historical dramas.

people.name: Daria Petrov
people.bio: She first performed as a concert violinist and brings a musician's precision to restrained screen roles.

people.name: Yui Kasahara
people.bio: She voices spirited anime leads with a bright edge that can turn solemn without losing warmth.

people.name: Misaki Endo
people.bio: She became a sought-after voice performer through understated portrayals of mentors and reluctant rivals.

people.name: Akane Fujita
people.bio: She trained in dance and gives animated athletes a convincing sense of breath, effort and stubborn pride.

people.name: Reina Morita
people.bio: She moves easily between gentle domestic stories and unsettling mysteries in her voice work.

people.name: Hana Shibata
people.bio: She is recognized for voicing impulsive heroines whose courage arrives before their plan does.

people.name: Keira Bell
people.bio: She has a gift for making stubborn authority figures feel both formidable and unexpectedly tender.

people.name: Selma Ortiz
people.bio: She came to television after years in improvisational theater and excels at scenes that turn on a single misunderstanding.

people.name: Naomi Fischer
people.bio: She often plays investigators, grounding procedural twists in the small fatigue of patient observation.

people.name: Farah Haddad
people.bio: She is drawn to ambitious characters who conceal their doubts behind impeccable preparation.

people.name: Ada Mercer
people.bio: She made her screen debut as a school debater and has since played teenagers with an unusually candid sense of humor.

people.name: Milo Renner
people.bio: He is known for playing charming men whose certainty dissolves once a plan meets ordinary life.

people.name: Owen Kade
people.bio: He spent years in repertory theater and lends weary authority to detectives and ship captains alike.

people.name: Rafael Vega
people.bio: He built his reputation in ensemble comedy, especially as optimists who talk faster than they think.

people.name: Idris Bello
people.bio: He brings a measured intensity to roles shaped by duty, rivalry and the cost of keeping a secret.

people.name: Caleb Moss
people.bio: He began in sketch comedy and is particularly adept at characters trying to hide a catastrophic mistake.

people.name: Elian Roux
people.bio: He has played scholars and swindlers with the same patient, disarming stillness.

people.name: Basil Chow
people.bio: He trained in dance before screen acting and gives even small comic roles a precise physical rhythm.

people.name: Theo Arden
people.bio: He gravitates toward earnest outsiders and makes their risky decisions feel painfully considered.

people.name: Samir Rahman
people.bio: He is a former stage magician whose screen work often hides a sly joke beneath a serious face.

people.name: Luca Ferretti
people.bio: He is celebrated for humane portraits of fathers, judges and other men asked to make irreversible choices.

people.name: Sota Mizuno
people.bio: He voices hotheaded anime heroes while keeping their fears close enough to hear between the shouts.

people.name: Kenta Orihara
people.bio: He gives animated antagonists an unusually calm cadence and finds humor in their vanity.

people.name: Ryo Tanabe
people.bio: He is best known for voicing anxious students who discover courage through friendship and practice.

people.name: Daichi Kuroda
people.bio: He specializes in laconic pilots and detectives whose restraint gives way at decisive moments.

people.name: Haruki Noma
people.bio: He brings a gentle comic touch to animated dreamers and unlikely team captains.

people.name: Julian Frost
people.bio: He is prized for wry performances that leave room for a character's regret to surface slowly.

people.name: Mateo Silva
people.bio: He worked as a carpenter before acting and brings a practical ease to working-class characters.

people.name: Jonah Reed
people.bio: He is drawn to characters whose generosity becomes a liability when pressure mounts.

people.name: Nikhil Sethi
people.bio: He gained notice in school productions for making quiet rivalries feel urgent and funny.

people.name: Adrian Sloane
people.bio: He often plays poised executives whose private panic leaks through small, revealing gestures.

people.name: Mara Bellamy
people.bio: She creates dramas about institutions under strain, drawing on her years reporting on municipal government.

people.name: Devon Kersey
people.bio: He writes character comedies shaped by his experience managing a chaotic community arts center.

people.name: Celia Okafor
people.bio: She develops mysteries in which the evidence changes how families understand their own histories.

people.name: Tomas Ibarra
people.bio: He writes adventurous series that ground extravagant premises in ordinary practical problems.

people.name: Iris Chen
people.bio: She creates intimate family and teen stories attentive to the things people choose not to say aloud.

people.name: Gideon Vale
people.bio: He favors period settings and political bargains, with years of historical research behind his scripts.

people.name: Natsumi Arai
people.bio: She writes animated journeys about friendship, appetite and the surprising rules of unfamiliar places.

people.name: Haruto Seki
people.bio: He builds anime stories around ambitious teams learning the price of a shared victory.

people.name: Keiko Mori
people.bio: She writes romances and mysteries where small domestic details become decisive clues.

people.name: Ren Takahashi
people.bio: He creates speculative series focused on engineers, pilots and the consequences of ambitious inventions.

movies.title: Kestrel
movies.tagline: The mountain keeps its own map.
movies.synopsis: Surveyor Ada Venn joins pilot Elias Kade to chart a remote pass above the town of Calder. When a landslide strands their crew, Ada must choose between completing the survey and guiding a rival expedition to safety.

movies.title: The Orchard Lease
movies.synopsis: In coastal Valmera, teacher Lina Cho inherits a failing pear orchard from an uncle she barely knew. A seasonal worker offers to keep it alive, but the deed names a buyer who arrives before the fruit is ripe.

movies.title: Blackwater Signal
movies.synopsis: Radio engineer Yeri Han hears a distress call from a lighthouse that has been dark for nine years. She takes a ferry to Blackwater Island, where a retired keeper insists the voice belongs to his dead brother.

movies.title: Sunday at Mero
movies.synopsis: At her grandmother's café in Mero, Priya Shah promises four feuding cousins the same job running the annual fair. Her improvised auditions turn the village upside down just as a food critic arrives unannounced.

movies.title: Tin Bird Summer
movies.synopsis: In a sleepy river town, Mika Sato builds a mechanical bird from discarded clock parts and discovers it repeats tomorrow's sounds. She and her brother must decide whether to warn the town about a storm no forecaster believes is coming.

movies.title: Copper Line
movies.synopsis: Transit inspector Vera Illich finds a smuggling route hidden inside the copper wiring of a new subway line in Bracken. Her partner Malik wants an arrest, but Vera suspects the depot chief is protecting a witness.

movies.title: Salt on the Wind
movies.synopsis: Archivist Mara Velez travels the tidal farms of North Haven to record the last crews harvesting sea salt by hand. Her interviews with farmer Elka Sabo reveal how a proposed seawall would erase both their livelihood and a centuries-old channel system.

movies.title: Ashfall Station
movies.synopsis: A remote weather station receives measurements from a volcanic eruption that has not happened yet. Technician Laila Bako traces the readings to a damaged satellite while a minister orders the data buried to prevent an evacuation panic.

movies.title: Ghosts of the Viaduct
movies.synopsis: After inheriting a boardinghouse beneath the Bellwether viaduct, Mara Velez hears a train cross the bridge each night although its tracks were removed decades ago. A tenant disappears after following the sound into a sealed service tunnel.

movies.title: The Glass Coronet
movies.tagline: A crown can be a prison.
movies.synopsis: In the divided city of Ardenne, court artisan Isabel Vale is ordered to repair a ceremonial crown before the young regent's first public address. She discovers the jewels are replicas and must find who sold the originals before blame falls on her apprentice.

movies.title: The Midnight Rehearsal
movies.synopsis: A touring brass band misses its ferry and persuades a shuttered theater in Rensby to host one last show. Singer Yuna Bell must keep the musicians together while the theater's owner quietly negotiates its demolition.

movies.title: Paper Moon Fox
movies.synopsis: When the moon vanishes over the village of Lyst, young Elin folds a fox from her grandfather's letters. The creature comes alive and leads her through forgotten stories, but every fold erases a memory she wants to keep.

movies.title: Lantern Bay
movies.synopsis: At Lantern Bay, teenage Anika Mehta discovers that the island's lighthouse will be sold after its keeper falls ill. She recruits a ferry mechanic and a retired surveyor to prove the beacon still protects the fishing fleet.

movies.title: La Dernière Carte
movies.synopsis: Cartographer Alma Ríos returns to her childhood home in Marseille after a warehouse fire exposes a hidden street on an old city map. Her father denies the street existed, even as former residents begin to receive letters from it.

movies.title: Canyon of Ashes
movies.synopsis: Rancher Nadia Farouk rides into the dry settlement of Corva to recover horses stolen during a survey dispute. She learns the new boundary puts the town's only well under the control of the man who hired the thieves.

movies.title: The Ferry Battalion
movies.synopsis: During a winter retreat, nurse Binta Sarr commandeers a civilian ferry to evacuate wounded soldiers from Loma Harbor. A delayed order demands she return for military cargo, leaving the crew to decide whose lives count as essential.

movies.title: Riverboat Ruse
movies.synopsis: Celeste Marin sells tickets to a supposedly luxurious river cruise that turns out to be a produce barge. When a jewel courier boards by mistake, she must keep her passengers entertained while deciding whether to return his missing case.

movies.title: The Ninth Door
movies.synopsis: Restorer Maeve Quinn counts eight doors in the empty Bellamy Hotel until a ninth appears after midnight. Inside she finds objects from guests who vanished decades earlier, and the concierge warns that returning one will invite its owner back.

movies.title: Violet Inventory
movies.synopsis: Museum registrar Leila Haddad discovers that every object in a small Paris collection has been mislabeled by a lovesick former curator. She asks visiting conservator Wei Chen for help, then finds his own family history threaded through the catalog.

movies.title: Harbor of Keys
movies.synopsis: After a locksmith dies in Port Lune, his daughter Camille inherits a wall of unclaimed keys and a ledger with no addresses. She follows one key to a boarded school and uncovers why her father stopped speaking to the town's mayor.

movies.title: Havets Tavshed
movies.tagline: The sea kept a second log.
movies.synopsis: Dispatcher Marta Voss finds a passenger name added to the manifest after the ferry is sealed for winter in Aarhus. The harbor office calls it a clerical mistake, but a child's mitten appears in a cabin nobody rented.

movies.title: Summer Horn Section
movies.synopsis: Gina Ferraro takes over her uncle's struggling town band just weeks before the Brindle summer parade. She recruits a bus driver, two rival students, and a mechanic whose trumpet has not been played in twenty years.

movies.title: Starling Run
movies.tagline: One ship can outrun a system.
movies.synopsis: Freight pilot Samira Rahman discovers that the navigation beacons around Port Oris have been secretly redirected to strand refugee vessels. She steals a fast courier called Starling and races to broadcast the true coordinates before the patrol fleet closes in.

movies.title: Desert Postmark
movies.tagline: The letter took the long road.
movies.synopsis: In the dry town of San Oriel, postal clerk Talia Reed receives a love letter addressed to a woman buried thirty years earlier. She rides with a reluctant guide to find the sender and learns the dead woman's daughter has been waiting for an answer.

movies.title: Second Floor Snow
movies.synopsis: Apartment caretaker Aisha Mir tries to conceal a burst pipe before her building's fussy owner arrives for inspection. As snow falls inside the upstairs ballroom, the tenants turn the disaster into an unauthorized winter festival.

movies.title: Wake of the North
movies.synopsis: Marine biologist Elise Laurent boards a research cutter near Sable Point to retrieve a sensor trapped beneath pack ice. When the ship's captain refuses to turn back from a dangerous channel, she discovers he is following a signal from his missing son.

movies.title: Ink House
movies.synopsis: Ada Mensah takes a cheap room above a print shop in Fenwick and wakes to find yesterday's conversations typed across the wallpaper. The messages begin changing before anyone speaks, warning her that the landlord plans to lock the building at dawn.

movies.title: Clockwork Pier
movies.synopsis: In a harbor built on giant gears, apprentice Elin must restart the pier clock before the spring tide leaves every fishing boat stranded. A stubborn sea gull knows where the missing brass key went, but demands a favor first.

movies.title: Broken Census
movies.tagline: A missing column changed a city.
movies.synopsis: Historian Salma Idrissi examines the 1942 census of Westbridge, where an entire neighborhood disappeared from the official count. Residents and archivists piece together how a property scheme used that omission to deny families their homes.

movies.title: Bellweather Kitchen
movies.synopsis: When a critic mistakes Clara Weiss's retirement home for a new restaurant, she and cook Alma Ruiz decide to serve him anyway. Their improvised menu becomes a local sensation, threatening the quiet routine the residents had finally earned.

movies.title: The Alder Trial
movies.synopsis: Public defender Iris Bell takes a murder case in Alder County after the only eyewitness changes her account three times. A forgotten bus ticket points to a second passenger who could clear her client, if she can find him before sentencing.

movies.title: La Casa Vacía
movies.synopsis: Eszter Nagy arrives in the hill village of Aranda to sell her sister's vacant house. Each morning the furniture returns to its old arrangement, and a local mason admits he has been hearing her sister sing through the walls.

movies.title: The Marble Violin
movies.synopsis: Cellist Jo Park finds an unfinished concerto tucked inside a damaged instrument at the Cavan conservatory. She asks an aloof pianist to help perform it, then learns the score was abandoned during a public feud between their grandparents.

movies.title: Kestrel: White Ridge
movies.tagline: The second route has a price.
movies.synopsis: Thirty years after opening Calder Pass, Ada Venn returns to guide a rescue across White Ridge when a new tunnel collapses. Pilot Elias Kade is flying for the mining company that ignored her warnings, forcing old allies to trust each other under fire.

movies.title: Thorn and Tide
movies.tagline: The garden grew toward the sea.
movies.synopsis: Gardener Lina Cho is hired to restore a walled estate on the island of Merrow, where every plant blooms only at night. Her young assistant finds a path that appears with the tide, and Lina must decide whether to reveal it to the estate's impatient owner.

movies.title: Iron Parade
movies.synopsis: In wartime Brenna, field medic Nari Choi joins a civilian convoy carrying replacement machine parts to a besieged hospital. The officer assigned to protect them receives orders to seize the cargo for an armored unit, and the drivers refuse to unload.

movies.title: Bamui Jido
movies.tagline: A map waited for its owner.
movies.synopsis: In Seoul, archivist Jiyun is asked to identify a hand-drawn map found in a demolished music hall. Every address marks a place where a pianist once met a stranger, including a café owned by the man who claims not to know her.

movies.title: Blue Hour Dam
movies.synopsis: Engineer Hana Mori notices that the floodgates at Eastmere Dam open seconds before their control signals arrive. She traces the anomaly to a buried communications array while a festival downstream leaves thousands in the spillway.

movies.title: Sparrow Court
movies.synopsis: At Sparrow Court, tenants Zora and Samira form a fake homeowners' board to stop a developer from buying their building. Their forged notices become so effective that a real city inspector asks them to investigate a missing maintenance fund.

movies.title: Copper Line: Night Switch
movies.synopsis: Inspector Vera Illich is drawn back to Bracken's subway when a witness from the original copper case vanishes during a scheduled power cut. Malik Noor finds the same hidden wiring route has been repurposed to move evidence out of police storage.

movies.title: Last Light Library
movies.synopsis: Laila Bako volunteers at a library scheduled to close in the hill town of Orin. After sundown, unfinished stories step out of their bindings, and she has one week to help the children finish a tale that can save the building.

movies.title: Ocean Mile
movies.tagline: The swim crossed no finish line.
movies.synopsis: Swimmer Elise Laurent attempts a cold-water route between the islands of Nerr and Tor to raise money for a rescue boat. The film follows her training, the volunteer pilots, and the fishing families who challenge the route's safety.

movies.title: Kaze no Michi
movies.synopsis: In coastal Iwato, conservator Mika Tanabe is hired to restore a map damaged by salt air. She follows its old walking route with musician Haru and learns the path was designed to bring separated neighbors home after storms.

movies.title: Civic Holiday
movies.synopsis: Town clerk Yuna Seo approves a one-day public holiday by checking the wrong box on a council form. When everyone in Bellport refuses to go back to work, she has to stage an emergency vote without admitting that the mayor is away fishing.

movies.title: Vellum Kingdom
movies.synopsis: An apprentice illustrator in Nareth discovers that painted borders are shrinking the kingdom each night. She enters a giant atlas to confront its lonely maker, who believes erasing roads will keep his daughter from leaving.

movies.title: Marrow Field
movies.tagline: The fence came after the graves.
movies.synopsis: Ranch hand Anika Mehta finds survey stakes driven through an old burial ground outside Marrow Field. She gathers testimony from the families who remember the site while a cattle company sends riders to move the markers overnight.

movies.title: Vault Seven
movies.synopsis: Security architect Alma Ruiz discovers a hidden seventh vault beneath the bank she designed in Grayson. When thieves take her brother hostage, she must guide them through her own defenses while quietly steering them toward the sealed evidence inside.

movies.title: Canal Weather
movies.synopsis: Architect Binta Diallo returns to Saint-Louis to assess a canal bridge slated for removal. An old friend who pilots the morning ferry challenges her report, and their arguments uncover a safer repair that could save his route.

movies.title: Red Umbrella Club
movies.synopsis: Nisha Rao enrolls in a rain-soaked neighborhood choir to escape her noisy apartment, only to discover it is a secret percussion society. Their first public show coincides with a council hearing about the building they rehearse in.

movies.title: La Strada Stretta
movies.synopsis: In Naples, courier Giulia Serra witnesses a council aide exchange a briefcase in a narrow lane moments before he is killed. She can identify the buyer, but her brother Marco's delivery van appears in every security image from the scene.

movies.title: Feather Market
movies.synopsis: At Bracken's annual bird fair, young Mina Cho accidentally releases a rare blue finch meant for the closing ceremony. She enlists a rival contestant and an impatient bus driver to find it before the mayor unveils an empty cage.

movies.title: Lantern Bay: Low Tide
movies.synopsis: After the lighthouse is saved, a low tide reveals a stone path leading from Lantern Bay to an uncharted wreck. Harbor clerk Sofia Vale and young deckhand Nari Choi follow Anika's old charts, then discover salvagers have already marked the wreck for demolition.

movies.title: Pale Orbit
movies.synopsis: On an aging orbital station, medic Priya Nair realizes the crew's sleep cycles are drifting because the habitat has begun to slow. She must persuade an engineer who falsified maintenance records to expose the fault before a supply craft docks.

movies.title: The Island Ledger
movies.synopsis: Researcher Hana Mori follows a century of handwritten ferry ledgers on the island of Treva. Interviews with island families reveal how seasonal workers kept the port running while official histories left them unnamed.

movies.title: Do Kinare
movies.synopsis: In the river town of Ratan, tailor Meera inherits a shop on the opposite bank from her family home. A bridge repair traps her there with reserved ferryman Arun, and the two organize neighbors to reopen the crossing before monsoon season.

movies.title: The Mineral Room
movies.synopsis: Geologist Ingrid Solberg brings an unusual mineral core from the quarry at Durn to her university laboratory. The samples swell whenever the lights go out, and the night custodian vanishes after hearing his own voice inside one of them.

movies.title: The Ribbon Factory
movies.tagline: A strike began with a color.
movies.synopsis: Seamstress Aisha Qureshi takes a night job at the Lenton ribbon mill and discovers its new dyes are making workers sick. Her supervisor offers a promotion for silence, while her sister has already printed leaflets naming the owners.

movies.title: Soft Landing
movies.synopsis: Elise Laurent buys a tiny airfield outside Briar Glen thinking it is a flower nursery. She tries to convert the hangar into a greenhouse, but the local flight instructor keeps landing there with students and an increasingly elaborate excuse.

movies.title: Die Letzte Fähre
movies.synopsis: Near Hamburg, ferry dispatcher Mara Beck receives a final ticket for a route canceled years ago. She follows the passenger list to a warehouse where abandoned luggage is being cataloged under the names of living residents.

movies.title: Skyline Gardeners
movies.synopsis: Community organizer Rina Sato documents residents turning three neglected rooftops in Eastfield into shared gardens. Their work faces a setback when the property owner sells the buildings, prompting a campaign to protect the harvest and the tenants.

movies.title: Firebreak Road
movies.synopsis: Wildfire coordinator Salma Idrissi must evacuate the mountain hamlet of Keswick after a change in wind traps residents on the wrong side of a firebreak. A road crew working nearby can open a passage, but only if she risks sending them into the smoke.

movies.title: Cedar Plain
movies.synopsis: In Cedar Plain, Clara Weiss owns the only general store left after a railroad bypasses the settlement. When a survey team offers to move the station sign to her land, she discovers the deed would transfer the town's well to a distant investor.

movies.title: Silver Circuit
movies.synopsis: Detective Iris Bell investigates a jewelry theft in New Aster after security footage shows the stolen necklace walking out on a service robot. Its manufacturer blames a software fault, but an engineer finds a handwritten command hidden in the machine's route file.

movies.title: Marrow Song
movies.synopsis: After her mother's funeral in Aranda, Binta Diallo discovers a field recording of a song no one in the family admits to knowing. She follows its melody to a closed textile mill, where former workers remember the protest that changed the town.

movies.title: Poppy and Iron
movies.synopsis: In a city divided by a long ceasefire, young Poppy sends a windup iron bird across the barricade to find her missing brother. The toy passes from hand to hand, carrying a message neither side's commanders will allow through.

movies.title: Hushwater
movies.synopsis: At Hushwater Camp, caretaker Ada Venn hears children calling from a drained lakebed after the summer season ends. Her friend Miriam follows the voices into an old pumping station and finds a door wet on both sides.

movies.title: The Ninth Door: Guestbook
movies.synopsis: A decade after the Bellamy Hotel was sealed, archivist Lina Cho discovers a guestbook listing visitors who have not been born yet. She enters the building with a demolition surveyor, hoping to find Maeve Quinn's missing notes before the ninth room opens again.

movies.title: Little Copper Town
movies.synopsis: When a copper mine closes in the town of Elsen, student Nari Choi proposes using its siren tower as a community radio station. The mine manager objects until her first broadcast reunites workers scattered after the shutdown.

movies.title: The Saffron Vote
movies.synopsis: In the market town of Narol, vendor Priya Nair is nominated for council after joking that the mayor should tax stale bread. Her campaign gains momentum when she promises to settle a decades-old dispute over the public spice garden.

movies.title: Beyond Juniper
movies.synopsis: Scout Hana Mori leads a wagon of botanists beyond Juniper Ridge to locate a rare medicinal shrub. Their sponsor plans to fence the valley once they find it, so she must guide the plants' caretakers to the survey camp first.

movies.title: Dead Letter Convoy
movies.tagline: The mail carried a route home.
movies.synopsis: During a border war, courier Samira Rahman finds letters addressed to soldiers officially listed as dead. She follows their regiment's abandoned supply route and discovers survivors being held to conceal a failed evacuation.

movies.title: Small Hours Hotel
movies.synopsis: Night manager Ingrid Solberg accidentally books a seaside hotel for two rival wedding parties on the same weekend. She assigns them alternating floors, but the couples keep meeting at the only working elevator.

movies.title: Reef Keepers
movies.synopsis: Marine ranger Ingrid Solberg joins fishers at Oru Reef to document a volunteer effort to restore storm-damaged coral shelves. Their work is interrupted by an illegal dredging crew, giving the camera a close view of the community's fight over its waters.

movies.title: Morning Witness
movies.tagline: The camera faced the wrong way.
movies.synopsis: In Westbridge, courthouse photographer Mara Velez sees a defendant leave by a side door minutes before his recorded acquittal. Her negatives reveal that the person in court was a double, and the real man has her address.

movies.title: Auburn Satellite
movies.tagline: A message came from the wheat.
movies.synopsis: Astronomer Noemi Costa discovers that a farm's irrigation system is transmitting an old satellite code every sunrise. Its owner wants the equipment shut off, but the signal may be the only record of a missing research mission.

movies.title: Honeycomb Stairs
movies.synopsis: Yuna Seo finds a staircase inside her aunt's attic that descends into a miniature village of beekeepers. When a cold snap threatens the colony, she brings their queen to the warm school greenhouse without letting her aunt see the tiny procession.

movies.title: Sable Chorus
movies.synopsis: Eva Lind takes a teaching post on Sable Island and finds the school choir has been canceled to fund a new seawall. She organizes a concert on the exposed beach, hoping the visiting officials will hear the children before signing the order.

movies.title: El Puente Roto
movies.synopsis: In the mountain town of Oliva, engineer Lucía discovers that the bridge she was hired to repair was deliberately damaged during a land dispute. She must persuade both sides to testify before the rainy season cuts off the valley.

movies.title: Sundial Office
movies.synopsis: A minor clerk in Orlo discovers that the office sundial moves backward whenever someone lies on a government form. Anika Mehta uses it to solve a missing-paycheck dispute, then learns the entire payroll is due for a mysterious revision.

movies.title: Starling Run: Dark Beacon
movies.synopsis: Years after freeing the shipping lanes, Samira Rahman discovers a beacon still sending false coordinates from an abandoned moon outpost. She takes Starling back into restricted space with Idris Noor, only to find survivors who depend on the signal to stay hidden.

movies.title: The Pearl Index
movies.synopsis: In Bellport, appraiser Iris Bell notices that pearls stolen from three homes were all once owned by the same diver. A retired auctioneer knows where they came from but will only speak after she recovers a missing ledger.

movies.title: Bracken Bus
movies.synopsis: Driver Elka Sabo takes her last bus run through Bracken, but the passengers refuse to let the service end quietly. They organize an impromptu parade of stops and accidentally deliver Councilman Vare to the neighborhood slated to lose transit.

movies.title: Sous la Pluie
movies.synopsis: In Lyon, pianist Céline is asked to accompany a children's choir outdoors despite a week of storms. She meets stage builder Étienne, whose temporary shelter becomes the only place in town where rehearsals can continue.

movies.title: Cinder Watch
movies.tagline: The fire never reached this floor.
movies.synopsis: Night guard Maeve Collins patrols a rebuilt theater in Carrow where smoke appears in one balcony every evening. A box of tickets from the original fire bears tomorrow's date, and she finds four seats already reserved for the demolition crew.

movies.title: Toward the Furnace
movies.synopsis: During a siege of Loden, mechanic Leila Haddad leads civilians through an abandoned furnace complex to reach the river. An officer wants to destroy the plant to block enemy vehicles, but her sister is still searching its tunnels for trapped workers.

movies.title: Winter Platform
movies.tagline: The last train carried a vote.
movies.synopsis: Union organizer Camille Moreau stays behind at the frosted Lorne station when management announces its closure. She persuades stranded passengers to testify about the line's importance before the council's morning meeting.

movies.title: The Moth Engine
movies.synopsis: In the floating city of Nacre, child inventor Hana Mori builds a moth-shaped engine to repair the failing night lamps. The device instead heads toward the dark side of the city's central tower, where an older power source has been hidden.

movies.title: Seed Bank Heist
movies.synopsis: Florist Lucia Ferraro plans to steal rare seeds from a private collection in Branton after the owner refuses to return them to local growers. Her team can crack the safe, but nobody has considered how to keep the seeds alive during the escape.

movies.title: The Quiet Estuary
movies.synopsis: Ecologist Samira Rahman investigates why migratory birds stopped visiting the Trenn estuary after a new channel was dredged. Fishermen, surveyors, and tide records point to a buried industrial pipe the operator insists was removed.

movies.title: Dalbit Gil
movies.synopsis: In Busan, photographer Minji returns to the hillside street where her parents first met and finds it marked for redevelopment. Sign painter Joon offers to help document its shops, but his family owns the company clearing them.

movies.title: Ridgewater County
movies.synopsis: Deputy Aisha Mir discovers that a new cattle route across Ridgewater County follows land secretly bought by the sheriff's cousin. She rides to warn the ranchers before a staged robbery provides a reason to seize their herds.

movies.title: Cedar Comet
movies.synopsis: At a summer camp near Cedar Lake, Elise Laurent finds a metal fragment that glows whenever the old observatory telescope points east. She convinces her skeptical counselor to follow its trail before the camp closes for the season.

movies.title: Market After Dark
movies.synopsis: Paramedic Ada Mensah responds to a call at the Wexley night market and finds every vendor has abandoned a still-warm stall. A security guard insists the market never opened, but a child is hiding beneath the fish counter.

movies.title: Celestial Laundry
movies.synopsis: Rina Sato inherits a laundry in Bellport where customers leave weather in their pockets. When a stranger brings in a coat full of falling stars, she and her brother must return them before the town's night sky goes blank.

movies.title: The Alabaster Route
movies.synopsis: Historian Salma Idrissi accompanies a survey team across the old Alabaster Route and finds mile markers that contradict official maps. A local guide reveals the markers were moved to hide a settlement erased after a failed mining venture.

movies.title: Canal Tomorrow
movies.synopsis: Engineer Clara Weiss returns to the canal village of Lowen after its lock system fails during a dry summer. Her niece Alma discovers a handwritten repair plan hidden in the town hall, but the council has already hired a contractor to fill the canal.

movies.title: Quiet Gallows
movies.synopsis: In the frontier town of Valen, deputy Iris Bell finds a signed execution order dated before the accused man's arrest. She follows the paper trail to a cattle syndicate whose debts depend on the prisoner's land.

movies.title: Soundings
movies.synopsis: Sound archivist Binta Diallo records ship horns and work songs at Saint-Louis harbor before the old docks close. Dockworkers help her reconstruct a call-and-response tradition that once guided boats through fog.

movies.title: The Folded City
movies.synopsis: Courier Jo Park discovers that entire streets in New Aster change positions while residents sleep. A transit planner believes a buried machine is reshaping the city, and Jo has until dawn to reach a hospital now cut off by a new wall.

movies.title: Apricot Season
movies.tagline: The fruit ripened all at once.
movies.synopsis: Nisha Rao agrees to manage her uncle's orchard near Faro for a single summer and immediately books two harvest crews for the same week. She makes them compete for a contract, then realizes one crew leader has been secretly repairing the irrigation lines.

movies.title: Cold Mosaic
movies.synopsis: Restorer Amara Okoye uncovers a second image beneath a railway station mural in Lorne. It depicts a passenger whose disappearance was never reported, and the station's new owner orders the wall covered before she can photograph it.

movies.title: Yuki no Tobira
movies.synopsis: Near Nagano, Aiko inherits a garden gate that opens only during the first snowfall. She crosses it to meet a younger version of her grandfather Ren and must decide whether to warn him about a choice that shaped her family.

movies.title: Amber Commission
movies.synopsis: City auditor Nari Choi is assigned to review a tiny public-art grant in Eastmere. The invoices lead to a decade of missing repair funds, and her mentor asks her to withdraw the report before the mayor's retirement ceremony.

movies.title: Aunties at Sea
movies.synopsis: Priya Nair and her aunt Ilona win a weekend yacht trip, only to find the skipper has left for a family emergency. They try to sail home by following tourist maps while a stowaway wedding planner keeps changing their destination.

movies.title: The Green Forge
movies.synopsis: Apprentice Hana Mori is the only worker left at a village forge after its owner falls ill. She persuades a retired carpenter to help finish a bridge hinge before the autumn rains isolate the farms across the river.

movies.title: Morrow Bridge
movies.synopsis: Maintenance chief Zora Petrovic discovers a remote override on the Morrow Bridge just before a relief convoy reaches it. She and dispatcher Samira Rahman must disable the mechanism while a saboteur uses the traffic cameras to track their moves.

movies.title: Fig Tree Hotel
movies.synopsis: Ingrid Solberg agrees to run a half-finished hotel in Bergen while its owner recovers from an injury. A visiting architect keeps moving the opening date, so she starts renting rooms to festival performers and lets their rehearsals decide the layout.

movies.title: Ghost Lanterns
movies.synopsis: During restoration of an old harbor fort in Accra, conservator Laila Bako finds lanterns that ignite whenever a visitor repeats a soldier's name. She stops the excavation after one flame follows a worker home and burns through his locked door.

movies.title: Pine and Paper
movies.synopsis: Young Ivy plants a paper crane in the snow above the village of Carrow and wakes to find a pine tree covered in undelivered letters. She carries them downhill before spring melts the path to their recipients.

movies.title: Briar Record
movies.synopsis: Noemi Costa inherits an old community radio archive in Briar Glen and finds a caller predicting the closure of its hospital. The recording is twenty years old, and the voice belongs to a patient whose medical file was erased.

movies.title: Late Harvest
movies.synopsis: After a storm ruins the family vineyard near Porto, Yuna Seo arrives to help her estranged father salvage the late grapes. A neighboring grower offers equipment in exchange for a future partnership, forcing her to decide whether she will stay beyond harvest.

movies.title: Outer Harbor
movies.synopsis: Outside Rensby, ferry captain Eva Lind spots a metal hull beneath the shoals after an unusually low tide. Its compartments contain fresh supplies dated years in the future, and an approaching research ship claims it before she can call the coast guard.

movies.title: The Bitter Acre
movies.synopsis: Rancher Anika Mehta refuses to sell a narrow strip of land along a drought-struck valley. A cattle baron sends workers to divert its spring, and she recruits a traveling surveyor to prove the water rights before the next roundup.

movies.title: Dusk Crossing
movies.synopsis: Field doctor Alma Ruiz needs to move patients across the Dulce River before shelling resumes at dawn. A reluctant ferry operator will take one final crossing, leaving her to choose which equipment can be abandoned without costing lives.

movies.title: Orchard Satellites
movies.synopsis: Agronomist Nadia Karim works with growers near Cairo to compare satellite images against changes they can see in their orchards. Their findings expose a missing irrigation branch and challenge the official drought estimate used to allocate water.

movies.title: Kestrel: Last Passage
movies.synopsis: Ada Venn's original map is found beneath Calder's closed survey office as spring floods threaten White Ridge. Her former trainee Binta Diallo leads a new rescue team along the unmarked route, while a mining company tries to seal the pass first.

movies.title: Thistle Hour
movies.synopsis: At a seaside bookshop in Kells, owner Celeste Marin finds anonymous notes predicting which patrons will return overdue books. She and musician Nisha Rao suspect a prank until one note points to a missing violin inside the shop's locked attic.

movies.title: Deepwater License
movies.synopsis: Harbor inspector Maeve Collins finds forged diving permits after a salvage worker goes missing near Cork. The licenses lead to a wreck whose cargo was never declared, and the company managing the search controls the rescue boats.

movies.title: A Taste of Rain
movies.synopsis: Chef Leila Haddad returns to her aunt's café in Tunis after its roof is damaged by a rare storm. The roofer helping her rebuild keeps leaving recipes from his late mother, drawing her into a friendship neither has time for.

movies.title: Brass and Bone
movies.synopsis: Musician Nari Choi buys a battered horn from a Busan estate sale and hears an unseen audience applaud each time she plays. The applause grows closer after she performs a melody written on the case's lining.

movies.title: Parcel for Tomorrow
movies.synopsis: Priya Nair receives a parcel at her Kochi apartment containing a school drawing her daughter has not made yet. More deliveries reveal an impending bus accident, and she has to convince the driver without explaining how she knows.

movies.title: The Ember Arch
movies.synopsis: After a wildfire exposes a stone arch near Eastmere, botanist Hana Mori steps through and finds a valley where last year's plants are still alive. A private survey crew follows her, intent on taking seeds before the arch closes with the first rain.

movies.title: Letters to Loden
movies.synopsis: During a wartime evacuation, Samira Rahman keeps a mobile post office running between two camps outside Loden. She grows close to a doctor whose letters she cannot deliver because the recipient's village has vanished from the maps.

movies.title: Tide Table
movies.synopsis: Archivist Ingrid Solberg follows four families whose handwritten tide tables guided ships into North Haven for a century. Their notebooks reveal changes in the coast that official charts did not record until years later.

movies.title: Ruby Carnival
movies.synopsis: When a road closure strands the Ruby Carnival floats in a narrow Accra street, organizer Laila Bako moves the festival into neighboring courtyards. An officious inspector tries to issue fines until his own marching band gets trapped in the procession.

movies.title: The Violet Fence
movies.synopsis: At a community garden in Lahore, Aisha Qureshi notices a fence shifting inward by inches each week. A retired surveyor helps her trace the altered boundary to a land transfer signed by someone who died years ago.

movies.title: Orbit Market
movies.synopsis: Elise Laurent opens a pop-up market on a remote space station and accidentally sells the captain's emergency supplies as vintage collectibles. With a supply ship delayed, she must persuade customers to return their purchases without revealing why.

movies.title: Moss and Mirrors
movies.synopsis: Botanist Ada Mensah inspects a greenhouse in Kumasi where mirrors have begun fogging with images of plants that are not there. After a gardener follows a reflected path into the wall, Ada discovers a root system spreading behind the glass.

movies.title: The Last Chorister
movies.synopsis: Rina Sato returns to her childhood concert hall in Sapporo for its planned final performance. The aging conductor falls ill, leaving her to lead a choir whose youngest members have never sung together in person.

movies.title: Copper Line: Ground Zero
movies.synopsis: A demolition under Bracken Station exposes the original copper smuggling tunnel and evidence Vera Illich never found. New investigator Salma Idrissi follows Malik Noor's old case notes, then learns the transit authority has scheduled a concrete pour for dawn.

movies.title: Hill Country Radio
movies.synopsis: Broadcast engineer Clara Weiss visits villages around Szeged that maintain a shared low-power radio network. Listeners and volunteer hosts explain how local weather reports became a lifeline during severe floods.

movies.title: Badlands Parcel
movies.synopsis: Courier Iris Bell is hired to carry a sealed parcel across the Badlands to a judge who keeps changing towns. A boastful sheriff insists on escorting her, unaware that the package contains his own overdue tax records.

movies.title: Slate Horizon
movies.synopsis: Mountaineer Binta Diallo is hired to guide a mapping team above the Slate Horizon quarry. Their sponsor has hidden a drilling rig beyond the ridge, and Binta must get her crew down before the first blast triggers an avalanche.

movies.title: Cloud Circus
movies.synopsis: Young Jo Park chases her family's traveling circus after a gust lifts its tents into the sky over Cavan. A cloud shepherd offers to guide her upward if she can help gather his lost flock of storm birds first.

movies.title: Velvet Invoice
movies.synopsis: Accountant Nisha Rao finds a luxury theater's books full of charges for performances that never happened. She stages a fake opening night to draw out whoever has been collecting the money, only to discover the audience is entirely made of creditors.

movies.title: Fogline
movies.synopsis: Port pilot Ada Venn guides a medical ship toward Calder through dense fog after the navigation buoys go dark. An anonymous radio voice offers a shortcut, but the coordinates lead toward a reef that vanished from recent charts.

movies.title: Paper Planet
movies.synopsis: Mina Cho receives a paper globe that grows whenever she adds a drawing to its surface. Her brother fills it with dangerous mountains for fun, leaving Mina to redraw a safe path for the tiny travelers trapped inside.

movies.title: The Pasture Deal
movies.synopsis: Ranch accountant Nari Choi realizes her employer has sold the same herd to three buyers in Juniper County. She tries to warn the drovers before the auction, but the sheriff is owed a share of the fraudulent sale.

movies.title: Blue Kitchen
movies.synopsis: Priya Nair enters a neighborhood cooking contest in Kochi using her late aunt's incomplete recipe. Rival cook Arjun offers the missing page, but only if she helps him reopen the seaside café where they first met.

movies.title: Hollow Ward
movies.synopsis: In an abandoned hospital outside Kyoto, Hana Mori catalogs equipment for an auction and finds fresh patient charts on empty beds. A security guard insists the ward was demolished, even while its corridor lengthens behind them.

movies.title: Lantern Bay: Open Water
movies.synopsis: A new rescue beacon at Lantern Bay fails during a squall, leaving a school sailing boat beyond the reef. Anika's preserved charts help harbor pilot Zora Petrovic and young dispatcher Samira Rahman navigate the older lighthouse route in time.

movies.title: After the Parade
movies.synopsis: Talia Reed returns to Chicago to lead the marching band she abandoned as a teenager. Its rehearsal hall is being sold, and she must win back the students' trust before asking them to perform at a fundraiser.

movies.title: Storm Records
movies.synopsis: Meteorologist Laila Bako compares oral histories of the 1978 Accra floods with official storm records. Residents identify neighborhoods omitted from the maps, changing the route proposed for a new flood barrier.

movies.title: Riverglass
movies.synopsis: Mara Velez finds translucent stones along the Fenwick River that replay moments from her childhood when held to the light. She gathers them to understand her brother's departure, then notices each stone erases the same moment from someone else's memory.

movies.title: The Night Orchard
movies.synopsis: At a research orchard near Porto, Noemi Costa discovers that fruit harvested after dark contains images of places that do not yet exist. An investor wants the crop shipped immediately, but one image shows the packing house burning the next morning.

movies.title: The Red Audit
movies.synopsis: Accountant Yuna Seo reviews a hospital charity in Incheon after its founder vanishes before an annual gala. The donations are real, but every recipient address leads to a building demolished years ago.

movies.title: Noon Harbor
movies.synopsis: Ferry cook Eva Lind prepares a retirement feast for her captain, but a timetable error sends the boat to the wrong island. With no passengers aboard, she serves the meal to a stranded school orchestra and asks them to play their way home.

movies.title: The Ninth Door: Ash Ledger
movies.synopsis: When the Bellamy Hotel burns, an ash-covered ledger arrives at Anika Mehta's archive with her name entered as its next guest. She returns to the site with former guest Maeve Quinn and finds the ninth door standing alone above an intact staircase.

movies.title: Dust and Cedar
movies.synopsis: Surveyor Alma Ruiz arrives in Cedar Plain to mark a new freight road across communal grazing land. An elderly storekeeper produces a faded charter proving the land was never sold, forcing Alma to challenge the company paying her wages.

movies.title: Aurora Farm
movies.tagline: The sky came down to harvest.
movies.synopsis: On a remote farm outside Glasgow, Iris Bell finds that her greenhouse windows capture the northern lights and release them at dawn. A visiting scientist offers to buy the glass, but Iris's daughter has begun using the light to guide lost hikers home.

movies.title: The Wrong Castle
movies.synopsis: Binta Diallo rents a country house for a quiet reunion, then discovers her cousins have arrived at a working historical reenactment castle. She tries to salvage the weekend while a rival family claims they booked the same banquet hall.

movies.title: The Remaining Note
movies.synopsis: After a concert hall closes in Dublin, cellist Jo Park discovers a missing final page in a score written for her teacher. A former rival has the page but refuses to hand it over until they perform the unfinished piece together.

movies.title: Starling Run: Home Signal
movies.synopsis: A generation after Starling exposed the false shipping lanes, a distress call reaches the courier from the hidden moon colony. New pilot Maeve Collins carries Samira's original coordinates through a blockade, while an aging navigator recognizes the signal as a warning about the colony's failing air supply.

movies.title: Last House on Rill
movies.synopsis: Leila Haddad visits the only house still standing after a flood in Rill Valley to collect her mother's belongings. The upstairs rooms are dry despite a collapsed roof, and each contains an object from a different family's evacuation.

movies.title: Beyond the Breakwater
movies.tagline: The old route found another shore.
movies.synopsis: Marine cartographer Camille Moreau joins a small crew searching for the lost channel beyond Port Lune's breakwater. When the sea floor shifts after a storm, her charts become the only way to bring two fishing boats safely home.

movies.title: Riverbend Assembly
movies.synopsis: Council clerk Sofia Alvarez misplaces the agenda for Riverbend's emergency meeting and lets residents propose their own business. What begins as a debate over a bus shelter exposes a land sale the mayor hoped to approve without discussion.

movies.title: Sable Light
movies.synopsis: At Sable Point, lighthouse engineer Maeve Collins discovers that the restored beacon illuminates houses miles from the coast. Each lit window reveals a figure standing behind its residents, and the ferry has already left for the night.

movies.title: The Broken Compass
movies.synopsis: While camping near Marrow Lake, Nisha Rao finds a compass that points toward people who need help. She follows it with a skeptical park ranger and reaches a flooded trail before the rescue team receives its first call.

movies.title: Garden of Small Fires
movies.tagline: The lamps came back one by one.
movies.synopsis: Historian Sofia Alvarez is hired to trace the old festival lantern route through Valparaiso. Electrician Mateo Rojas helps her restore the lamps, and their work reopens a family argument over why the celebration ended.

movies.title: Stone Harbor
