movies.synopsis: Diver Maeve Collins finds a freshly cut stone marker beneath the water at Stone Harbor, miles from the nearest quarry. She and investigator Nisha Rao follow its serial number to a shipment scheduled to disappear before sunrise.

shows.title: Breakwater House
shows.synopsis: At a storm-battered clinic in Port Orin, director Nora Vale discovers that the town's water reports were altered after a refinery spill. Her brother Ezra sits on the harbor board, leaving the clinic's future tied to a confession that could ruin their family.

episodes.title: Before the Sirens
episodes.synopsis: Miriam finds an old sampling ledger beneath Port Orin's clinic, giving Nora a way to date the contamination.

episodes.title: Low Tide Testimony
episodes.synopsis: Ezra returns to the harbor office for one last interview, risking his immunity to name the official who ordered the coverup.

episodes.title: Intake
episodes.synopsis: Nora treats three dockworkers in Port Orin after a strange rash appears, then loses the clinic's emergency funding when she requests water tests.

episodes.title: The Red Line
episodes.synopsis: Ezra discovers a revised survey in the harbor office and must decide whether to show Nora a page bearing his signature.

episodes.title: What the Well Kept
episodes.synopsis: Miriam traces the patients to one hillside well, but its owner threatens to close the only road to the clinic.

episodes.title: Board Minutes
episodes.synopsis: Nora confronts the harbor board in a packed school gym while Ezra learns who removed the original test results.

episodes.title: Storm Glass
episodes.synopsis: A gale cuts off Port Orin as Miriam safeguards the clinic's samples and Nora searches for a stranded patient.

episodes.title: The Harbor Vote
episodes.synopsis: Ezra brings the original ledger to the final board meeting, forcing Nora to choose between public disclosure and immediate care for the town.

shows.title: Queue Number
shows.synopsis: Permit clerk Della Finch inherits the worst service counter in Bellwick just as the city announces a competition for the friendliest office. Her team has six weeks to fix a ticket machine, a mysterious backlog and their reputation for losing wedding licenses.

episodes.title: The One with the Broken Bell
episodes.synopsis: Della's opening ceremony in Bellwick collapses when Gus wires the queue bell to the fire alarm and the mayor arrives early.

episodes.title: The One with Forty Brides
episodes.synopsis: Paco finds a box of unsigned marriage forms in the archives, leaving Della to locate forty couples before Friday.

episodes.title: Fern Trouble
episodes.synopsis: Gus accepts a lobby plant as a peace offering, but its hidden camera makes the Bellwick office's private complaints public.

episodes.title: Two Mayors, One Desk
episodes.synopsis: A scheduling error sends rival mayors to Della's desk at once, and Paco must keep their competing ribbon cuttings apart.

episodes.title: Window Gone
episodes.synopsis: Della learns her prize-winning service window is slated for demolition and stages a customer survey to save her team.

episodes.title: Service, Finally
episodes.synopsis: On judging day in Bellwick, Gus fixes the ticket machine while Della faces the couple whose license started the backlog.

shows.title: Glass County
shows.synopsis: Detective Mara Stein moves to Glass County for a quieter post and finds a string of thefts that follow abandoned rail routes. Archivist Ivo Marsh knows who bought the old maps, but revealing his source could expose his sister's part in the crimes.

episodes.title: Mileage Marker
episodes.synopsis: Mara investigates a stolen signal lamp at Rill Junction and finds fresh paint on a rail line closed for thirty years.

episodes.title: The Quiet Car
episodes.synopsis: Leah spots a hidden passenger in depot footage, putting Ivo's confidential map buyer under suspicion.

episodes.title: Switch House
episodes.synopsis: A fire at the old switch house destroys Mara's only fingerprint, so Ivo searches county land records for the new owner.

episodes.title: No Freight Listed
episodes.synopsis: Mara follows a phantom shipment to Glenford and catches Leah unloading medicine she insists was meant for a clinic.

episodes.title: The Fourth Spur
episodes.synopsis: Ivo admits that his sister found a fourth rail spur, sending Mara toward a vault beneath the disused quarry.

episodes.title: Last Train Out
episodes.synopsis: At the quarry, Mara must arrest Leah or let the stolen medicine reach patients before the buyer clears the vault.

shows.title: Second Horizon
shows.synopsis: Engineer Sol Reyes pilots a survey craft through a newly opened passage above the moon Nacre. Each trip returns her crew a few minutes ahead of their own messages, a discrepancy that could help evacuate a failing station or erase the warning entirely.

episodes.title: Drift Window
episodes.synopsis: Sol crosses the Nacre passage and receives a distress call from her own craft before the station announces any emergency.

episodes.title: A Minute Borrowed
episodes.synopsis: Naveen repeats the crossing near Nacre to check the clocks, but each attempt shortens the station's evacuation window.

episodes.title: The Sounding
episodes.synopsis: Pell decodes a future maintenance log and finds his name beside an accident that has not happened yet.

episodes.title: Stationkeeping
episodes.synopsis: Sol hides the log from Nacre's commander while Naveen searches for the valve that will begin the pressure loss.

episodes.title: Transit Message
episodes.synopsis: Pell sends a false all-clear through the passage to buy time, leaving Sol to locate the real distress beacon.

episodes.title: Beyond the Passage
episodes.synopsis: As Nacre loses air, Sol chooses which of two conflicting future messages to trust before launching the last shuttle.

shows.title: Final Plating
shows.synopsis: In the riverside kitchens of Bellmere, host Asha Venn asks six cooks to revive dishes nearly lost to family moves and closed restaurants. Judge Lionel March prizes technique, while contestant Kit Rowan wants to win without turning his grandmother's recipes into a spectacle.

episodes.title: Pantry Notes
episodes.synopsis: Asha visits Bellmere's old market to find the spice Kit needs for the final dish before its last vendor retires.

episodes.title: At Lionel's Table
episodes.synopsis: Lionel cooks his father's bean stew in the empty competition kitchen and explains why Kit's shortcut worried him.

episodes.title: First Fire
episodes.synopsis: Asha opens the Bellmere kitchen with a family breakfast challenge, and Kit burns the only copy of his grandmother's recipe card.

episodes.title: Market Day
episodes.synopsis: Lionel sends the cooks to the river market, where Kit must negotiate for a rare herb without exceeding the budget.

episodes.title: Saved from the Menu
episodes.synopsis: A closed cafe's former owner challenges Kit to recreate its lentil pie, testing whether he can accept a stranger's correction.

episodes.title: Overnight Broth
episodes.synopsis: Asha gives the cooks overnight access to Bellmere's ovens, but a power failure forces Kit to rebuild his broth outdoors.

episodes.title: Family Service
episodes.synopsis: Lionel invites the cooks' relatives to dinner, and Kit learns his grandmother deliberately left one ingredient off the card.

episodes.title: Last Plating
episodes.synopsis: For the final service in Bellmere, Kit must present the altered family dish and persuade Lionel that change can preserve its meaning.

shows.title: Wild Margin
shows.synopsis: Field biologist Tessa Rowan follows the animals living between farms and tidal marshes in the Varden Archipelago. With local ranger Malek Durr, she documents how a restored channel changes nesting routes, fishing grounds and the islanders' winter plans.

episodes.title: Saltgrass
episodes.synopsis: Tessa surveys the Varden saltgrass as nesting birds arrive, while Malek marks the plots threatened by a new footpath.

episodes.title: Channel Survey
episodes.synopsis: Malek opens a blocked tidal cut near East Varden, and Tessa records the first fish to return before the spring count.

episodes.title: Night Visitors
episodes.synopsis: Ines sets quiet cameras beside a farm wall to learn whether foxes or flooding are driving the island's hens away.

episodes.title: The Eel Run
episodes.synopsis: Tessa tracks young eels across Varden's shallow crossings, where a damaged culvert could stop the annual migration.

episodes.title: Winter Stores
episodes.synopsis: Ines compares seal feeding patterns with the fishers' catch records before a proposed seasonal closure divides the village.

episodes.title: A Narrow Shore
episodes.synopsis: Malek and Tessa revisit the restored channel after a storm, measuring whether the new wetland can protect Varden's nesting bank.

shows.title: Bellweather Files
shows.synopsis: Reporter Iris Dane reexamines the disappearance of a courthouse ledger in Bellweather, an event that ended a corruption trial without a verdict. Former clerk Tomas Velez preserved a box of receipts, and each page changes the timeline of the night his colleague vanished.

episodes.title: Bellweather
episodes.synopsis: Iris returns to the Bellweather courthouse and asks Tomas why the missing ledger was last seen after the trial adjourned.

episodes.title: North Annex
episodes.synopsis: At the North Annex, Tomas finds a receipt for a courier no witness remembered, putting the official timeline in doubt.

episodes.title: Ferry Point
episodes.synopsis: Iris interviews a ferry operator who saw the vanished clerk leave town, then checks whether the tide made that crossing possible.

episodes.title: Old Mill Road
episodes.synopsis: Detective Calder revisits a reported accident on Old Mill Road and discovers the victim's watch was logged two days late.

episodes.title: The Record Room
episodes.synopsis: Tomas unlocks a sealed cabinet in Bellweather and finds duplicate trial exhibits that implicate a second court employee.

episodes.title: County Line
episodes.synopsis: Iris traces the courier across the county line, where a living witness can finally explain why the ledger disappeared.

shows.title: Crown and Salt
shows.synopsis: In the coastal kingdom of Veyra, customs officer Elspeth Rane discovers that the royal salt tax is funding a secret fleet. Prince Lucan needs the ships to defend the strait, but admitting their existence could ignite a revolt among the families paying for them.

episodes.title: The Levy
episodes.synopsis: Elspeth audits a Veyran salt barge and finds naval timber hidden beneath the cargo before the harbor inspection.

episodes.title: Royal Measure
episodes.synopsis: Lucan offers Elspeth a court post to quiet her inquiry, but Sera warns that the fleet needs another month to sail.

episodes.title: Beneath the Customs Seal
episodes.synopsis: Sera intercepts a tax petition in Veyra and must decide whether exposing the ships will bring the dockworkers to her side.

episodes.title: The Strait in Winter
episodes.synopsis: A foreign scout reaches the strait, forcing Lucan to deploy one unfinished vessel without revealing the rest of his fleet.

episodes.title: Bread and Brine
episodes.synopsis: Elspeth meets protesting salt workers at the granary and learns their families cannot survive another levy.

episodes.title: Open Water
episodes.synopsis: With unrest spreading through Veyra, Elspeth proposes a public bargain that could fund Lucan's defense and end the secret tax.

shows.title: West of Friday
shows.synopsis: After a flood closes their high school in West Harlow, friends Bea, Niko and Lila must share classrooms with their longtime rivals across the river. Bea's campaign to save the old gym becomes complicated when she finds out her father approved the demolition plan.

episodes.title: Other Side
episodes.synopsis: Bea arrives at East Harlow High and claims an empty club room, risking a suspension before the gym campaign begins.

episodes.title: Lab Partners
episodes.synopsis: Niko pairs with a former rival in East Harlow's science wing and learns the flood data may help Bea's case.

episodes.title: The Painted Floor
episodes.synopsis: Lila leads a cleanup at the old West Harlow gym, but a safety notice threatens to cancel the fundraiser.

episodes.title: Permission Slip
episodes.synopsis: Bea steals a look at her father's council papers and finds a demolition vote scheduled before the student hearing.

episodes.title: Friday Lights
episodes.synopsis: Niko stages a joint school game on a temporary court, hoping the turnout will sway Harlow's undecided councilors.

episodes.title: The Hearing
episodes.synopsis: At town hall, Bea must disclose how she obtained the plans or let an inaccurate flood estimate decide the gym's fate.

shows.title: The Tinker House
shows.synopsis: In the hill town of Brindle, siblings Pip and Marnie turn their grandfather's repair shop into a rescue desk for everyday disasters. Their inventions rarely work on the first try, but neighbors keep returning because the pair always stay to fix the mess.

episodes.title: Umbrella Parade
episodes.synopsis: Pip builds a windproof umbrella for Brindle's parade, but Marnie must catch it before it carries the mayor uphill.

episodes.title: The Borrowed Bell
episodes.synopsis: Marnie replaces the school bell with a whistle machine and has until recess to find its missing spring.

episodes.title: Window Garden
episodes.synopsis: Grandpa Fen asks the children to save Mrs. Pruitt's window plants after their automatic watering hose floods her bakery.

episodes.title: Moonlight Delivery
episodes.synopsis: Pip promises to deliver a birthday cake across Brindle after dark, then discovers the cart cannot climb the final street.

episodes.title: The Great Button Hunt
episodes.synopsis: Marnie loses a coat button in the repair shop and follows a trail of mismatched buttons toward a neighbor's surprise gift.

episodes.title: Small Fixes
episodes.synopsis: When Brindle's fair loses power, Pip and Marnie ask everyone they helped to repair one part of the lantern display.

shows.title: The Ember Court
shows.synopsis: Ashkeeper Ilya Fen discovers that the fires protecting the city of Ardent are fed by memories taken from its citizens. To stop the ancient bargain, she must persuade exiled knight Corin to return before the winter court orders a final harvest.

episodes.title: The First Flame
episodes.synopsis: Young Sibel witnesses Ardent's first memory offering and hides the original bargain beneath the palace hearth.

episodes.title: An Exile's Road
episodes.synopsis: Corin crosses the frozen Vale Road after banishment, carrying a key that might open the ashkeeper's archive.

episodes.title: Ashfall
episodes.synopsis: Ilya finds a citizen who no longer recognizes his daughter and traces the loss to Ardent's central flame.

episodes.title: Knight's Return
episodes.synopsis: Corin slips through the winter gate to help Ilya reach the archive before Sibel's guards seal it.

episodes.title: The Price of Heat
episodes.synopsis: Sibel tells the court that Ardent's fire is failing, while Ilya discovers an untouched reserve of stolen childhood memories.

episodes.title: Cold Names
episodes.synopsis: Ilya releases one memory into the market and risks exposing its owner to the court's hunters.

episodes.title: The Ember Door
episodes.synopsis: Corin breaks the archive lock beneath Ardent, giving Sibel a final chance to reveal the bargain herself.

episodes.title: Winter Without Fire
episodes.synopsis: As the protective flames go dark, Ilya leads Ardent's families through the northern pass before the storm closes it.

shows.title: Motion to Seal
shows.synopsis: Public defender Ada Serrin learns that a sealed witness program in Halden is keeping innocent clients in jail to protect one lucrative informant. Her former mentor, prosecutor Lev Orsini, knows the arrangement is legal on paper and dangerous to challenge in open court.

episodes.title: Appearance
episodes.synopsis: Ada takes a routine arraignment in Halden and notices the witness code matches three unrelated defendants' files.

episodes.title: Protected Source
episodes.synopsis: Lev warns Ada that a disclosure motion could identify the informant, while Ruth locates a client who heard the same testimony twice.

episodes.title: In Camera
episodes.synopsis: Ada argues behind closed doors for the sealed records and discovers the judge was never shown the informant's payment history.

episodes.title: Material Omission
episodes.synopsis: Ruth finds an invoice tied to a Halden arrest, but its author disappears before Ada can call him to testify.

episodes.title: Contempt
episodes.synopsis: Lev threatens sanctions when Ada reads from a leaked memo, forcing her to prove its origin without exposing Ruth.

episodes.title: Open Record
episodes.synopsis: At the Halden hearing, Ada offers the court a narrow way to free her clients while Lev weighs the cost of admitting what he knew.

shows.title: Rooms for Tomorrow
shows.synopsis: Designer Mica Bell and builder Jo Ramires restore overlooked public rooms across the town of Alder Quay. Each renovation must honor the people who use the space and survive a modest budget, including a flood-prone library basement and a crowded youth hall.

episodes.title: The Reading Room
episodes.synopsis: Mica plans shelving for Alder Quay's basement library, but Jo discovers damp behind the walls before the books can return.

episodes.title: Six Folding Tables
episodes.synopsis: Evelyn asks the team to remake the youth hall, where Mica must fit homework desks around a weekly community supper.

episodes.title: Harbor Steps
episodes.synopsis: Jo rebuilds the harbor waiting room's entrance after a resident shows why the proposed ramp cannot handle winter ice.

episodes.title: Practice Space
episodes.synopsis: Mica turns an unused classroom into a rehearsal space, then has to calm neighbors who fear nightly noise.

episodes.title: The Shared Kitchen
episodes.synopsis: Evelyn gathers local cooks to test the new Alder Quay kitchen before Jo commits the last funds to its ventilation.

episodes.title: Doors Open
episodes.synopsis: As the library reopening approaches, Mica and Jo must repair a fresh leak without sacrificing the children's reading corner.

shows.title: Night Rounds
shows.synopsis: Dr. Sanaa Malik takes charge of the night shift at Marrow General just as the city closes its neighboring urgent-care center. Nurse Ed Cole knows the new arrivals need more than extra beds, and junior doctor Liv Park uncovers a medication error no one wants recorded.

episodes.title: After Midnight
episodes.synopsis: Sanaa receives a busload of patients at Marrow General and must open a closed ward before its only respiratory therapist leaves.

episodes.title: Bed Eleven
episodes.synopsis: Liv notices that a patient's dose was doubled during transfer, but her correction puts Ed's exhausted team under review.

episodes.title: Hospital Corridor
episodes.synopsis: Ed escorts a confused man through Marrow's packed corridors while Sanaa searches for his missing care records.

episodes.title: Shift Change
episodes.synopsis: Sanaa confronts the hospital board about unsafe staffing as Liv learns the medication error began on the day shift.

episodes.title: Call Light
episodes.synopsis: A citywide outage leaves Ed coordinating care by flashlight, and Liv must choose which patient receives the last portable monitor.

episodes.title: Morning Report
episodes.synopsis: At sunrise in Marrow General, Sanaa files an account of the error that could cost her job but protect the next night shift.

shows.title: Quiet Republic
shows.synopsis: Translator Mira Solis is sent to the border city of Neral to interpret talks over a disputed dam. When she recognizes a phrase from a supposedly dead informant, she suspects both delegations are hiding a third agreement that would displace thousands downstream.

episodes.title: The Interpreter
episodes.synopsis: Mira arrives in Neral and hears a forbidden phrase in a dam briefing, forcing her to question the source of her assignment.

episodes.title: Two Copies
episodes.synopsis: Omar hands Mira conflicting maps of the floodplain, and she must hide one before Hale searches the translators' room.

episodes.title: Downstream
episodes.synopsis: Mira visits the village of Cova and finds survey stakes where negotiators promised the water would never reach.

episodes.title: The Third Agreement
episodes.synopsis: Hale offers Mira safe passage out of Neral if she returns the missing map, revealing how much he knows about Omar.

episodes.title: Language of Consent
episodes.synopsis: Omar records a private meeting, but Mira realizes the translated village testimony has been quietly changed.

episodes.title: Spillway Signing
episodes.synopsis: Mira interrupts the dam signing in Neral with the original testimony, risking Omar's location to prevent the gates from opening.

shows.title: Little Lanterns
shows.synopsis: Bookbinder Nia Adebayo returns to the town of Larkhaven to repair a theater's century-old program archive. Stage manager Eli Mercer needs the theater open by autumn, and their growing affection is tested when Nia receives an offer to take the collection away for safekeeping.

episodes.title: Paper Doors
episodes.synopsis: Nia opens Larkhaven's damp archive and asks Eli to delay rehearsals before the oldest programs are damaged beyond repair.

episodes.title: Matinee Light
episodes.synopsis: Eli gives Nia a backstage tour to win her trust, but Camila reveals the theater cannot afford the repairs she recommends.

episodes.title: Better Binding
episodes.synopsis: Nia and Eli restore a torn program together, then disagree over whether its handwritten dedication belongs in the public display.

episodes.title: The Donor
episodes.synopsis: Camila finds a sponsor for the reopening in Larkhaven, provided Nia ships the fragile archive to a distant museum.

episodes.title: Dress Rehearsal
episodes.synopsis: Eli plans a benefit performance while Nia tests a local storage room that might keep the collection near its audience.

episodes.title: Opening Night
episodes.synopsis: With the curtain rising, Nia must choose where the archive belongs and tell Eli whether her own stay in Larkhaven can last.

shows.title: Public Comment
shows.synopsis: Bellwick council aide Finn Corley is assigned to run meetings that residents attend mainly to complain about parking. When a microphone accidentally broadcasts the council's private lunch order, Finn and clerk Rae Kim must keep a minor scandal from swallowing a genuine housing vote.

episodes.title: Two Minutes Each
episodes.synopsis: Finn gives Bellwick speakers a strict timer, then watches a retired choir director turn the housing hearing into a singalong.

episodes.title: The Agenda Packet
episodes.synopsis: Rae finds an extra page in the printed agenda and races Benny to every library branch before residents read a draft plan.

episodes.title: Closed Session
episodes.synopsis: Benny locks the council inside its own meeting room, leaving Finn to negotiate through the door with a waiting reporter.

episodes.title: Parking Study
episodes.synopsis: Finn commissions a parking survey that reveals council members have been using the only accessible spaces.

episodes.title: Lunch Order
episodes.synopsis: Rae investigates who left the chamber microphone on while Finn tries to keep the housing coalition from walking away.

episodes.title: Unanimous
episodes.synopsis: At Bellwick's final vote, Benny fixes the sound system and Finn allows an unplanned speaker whose story changes the room.

shows.title: Low Note
shows.synopsis: Cellist Anika Sorell takes over a struggling community orchestra in Dovetail after its conductor leaves midseason. Percussionist Benji Ray knows the players can fill the hall, but a disputed instrument loan could strip them of the sound they built together.

episodes.title: Tuning A
episodes.synopsis: Anika conducts her first rehearsal in Dovetail and discovers the bass section is playing on instruments due back in a week.

episodes.title: Borrowed Strings
episodes.synopsis: Benji searches the town for spare instruments while Anika asks their lender for time he refuses to give.

episodes.title: Rest Measure
episodes.synopsis: Mae proposes a smaller program for opening night, forcing Anika to tell the players which parts will be cut.

episodes.title: The Wrong Entrance
episodes.synopsis: A soloist misses her cue at the Dovetail school concert, and Benji improvises a rhythm that draws an unexpected sponsor.

episodes.title: Counterpoint
episodes.synopsis: Anika learns the sponsor wants naming rights to the orchestra, placing her uneasy partnership with Mae under strain.

episodes.title: Full House
episodes.synopsis: Before the sold-out Dovetail concert, Anika must settle the instrument debt or risk losing the ensemble after its best performance.

shows.title: Ashwater
shows.synopsis: Surveyor Ada Flint reaches the desert settlement of Ashwater to mark a new rail line through contested grazing land. Rancher Silas Crowe offers her shelter, but his missing deed and a water claim held by schoolteacher Pearl Navarro make every possible route somebody's ruin.

episodes.title: Survey Stakes
episodes.synopsis: Ada sets the first rail markers outside Ashwater and finds Silas has fenced the only safe crossing.

episodes.title: Dry Claim
episodes.synopsis: Pearl brings Ada a water claim from the schoolhouse, challenging the map issued by the distant rail office.

episodes.title: The Lost Deed
episodes.synopsis: Silas searches an abandoned mine for his deed while Ada learns the proposed route would drain Pearl's well.

episodes.title: A Line in Dust
episodes.synopsis: Ada moves a marker to spare Ashwater's grazing land, and the rail foreman threatens to replace her before sunrise.

episodes.title: The Crossing
episodes.synopsis: A flash flood strands Pearl's students near the rail camp, forcing Silas to open his fenced passage.

episodes.title: New Map
episodes.synopsis: At Ashwater's public survey, Ada presents a longer route and asks both claimants to sign before the rail office can reject it.

shows.title: Hollow Stair
shows.synopsis: Archivist Mara Venn inherits a boarding house in the village of Fenlock and hears footsteps climbing a staircase that ends at a wall. Her brother Leon finds names cut into the hidden risers, each belonging to a guest who vanished during the house's annual winter closure.

episodes.title: Check In
episodes.synopsis: Mara opens the Fenlock boarding house and hears a guest call from the sealed stairwell after every room has been checked.

episodes.title: Room Without a Door
episodes.synopsis: Leon finds an old room number behind the wall, but Eda warns that breaking through will begin the house's winter count.

episodes.title: Three Steps Up
episodes.synopsis: Mara follows wet footprints to the attic and discovers a missing guest's coat hanging beside her own.

episodes.title: The Winter Book
episodes.synopsis: Eda retrieves a ledger from Fenlock's chapel and reveals that one name appears under every year of disappearances.

episodes.title: No Vacancy
episodes.synopsis: Leon tries to flee the village, but the road returns him to the boarding house before Mara can finish sealing the stairs.

episodes.title: Last Landing
episodes.synopsis: As the hidden steps lengthen through the house, Mara calls the name in the ledger and risks becoming its next keeper.

shows.title: Morrow's Map
shows.synopsis: Cartographer Orin Morrow receives a map of his own city, Glenmere, marked with streets that vanished generations ago. Journalist Tess Ives joins his search for the original surveyor, only to find the missing lanes connect families who still claim ownership of the same square of land.

episodes.title: Unprinted Streets
episodes.synopsis: Orin traces a penciled lane beneath Glenmere's market and finds a doorway sealed by a modern shopfront.

episodes.title: The Surveyor's Son
episodes.synopsis: Tess interviews a descendant of Glenmere's surveyor while Pip discovers the family's papers were sold twice.

episodes.title: Under the Arcade
episodes.synopsis: Pip opens a hatch beneath the market arcade, giving Orin a route to the square that no current map records.

episodes.title: Boundary Stone
episodes.synopsis: Tess finds a stone marker in a schoolyard and must stop a demolition crew before its inscription is lost.

episodes.title: Four Claimants
episodes.synopsis: Orin brings Glenmere's rival families together, but an altered deed threatens to invalidate the only shared path.

episodes.title: The Open Square
episodes.synopsis: At a public hearing in Glenmere, Tess reveals the surveyor's original plan and asks the claimants to preserve the hidden square.

shows.title: The Long Way In
shows.synopsis: Travel writer Celeste Marr follows the lesser-used roads between the mountain villages of the Orrel Range. Local guide Davi Noor introduces the people who keep routes open through landslides and snow, making each arrival a story of shared work rather than a scenic shortcut.

episodes.title: Stone Bridge
episodes.synopsis: Celeste crosses the Orrel Range's oldest bridge with Davi, whose neighbors must repair its parapet before market day.

episodes.title: Upper Path
episodes.synopsis: Davi leads Celeste above a landslide near Rova, where a shepherd shows why the detour matters to winter supplies.

episodes.title: The Orchard Road
episodes.synopsis: Rosa invites the travelers to help harvest at Lemen, but an early frost threatens the village's only pressing day.

episodes.title: Last Bus to Vale
episodes.synopsis: Celeste boards the final bus through the Orrel pass and learns how its driver delivers medicine beyond the official route.

episodes.title: Snow Marker
episodes.synopsis: Davi teaches Celeste to read painted trail signs before heavy snow hides the path to his childhood home.

episodes.title: Homeward Track
episodes.synopsis: Back in Rova, Celeste joins Rosa's road crew and sees whether a repaired crossing can keep the valley connected all winter.

shows.title: Club Meridian
shows.synopsis: Coach Rafi Bell takes charge of Meridian's underfunded women's rowing club after its boathouse is condemned. Captain Lora Venn can keep the team together for one season, but their only chance at the regional regatta depends on sharing water with a rival club.

episodes.title: First Stroke
episodes.synopsis: Rafi gathers the Meridian rowers at a borrowed dock and learns Lora has promised them a boat the club cannot afford.

episodes.title: Shared Water
episodes.synopsis: Nell negotiates practice hours with the rival Eastbank crew, but Lora refuses to yield the dawn slot.

episodes.title: The Split
episodes.synopsis: A rough practice on Meridian Lake reveals a timing flaw that Rafi can fix only by changing Lora's seat.

episodes.title: Headwind
episodes.synopsis: Nell injures her wrist before a qualifying race, forcing Lora to trust a novice in the stern.

episodes.title: Boathouse Vote
episodes.synopsis: Rafi asks Meridian's council for repair funds while the team races a time trial to prove the season is worth saving.

episodes.title: At the Line
episodes.synopsis: During the regional final, Lora calls a risky pace change that could win the race or leave Nell unable to finish.

shows.title: Borrowed Weather
shows.synopsis: Meteorologist Hana Vale discovers that a private weather array above the city of Selden is diverting rain toward paying districts. Technician Owen Marr helped build it and offers proof, but shutting down the array during a heat wave could trigger a storm the city can no longer forecast.

episodes.title: Dry Block
episodes.synopsis: Hana measures a sharp rainfall divide in Selden and catches an array beacon turning toward the wealthiest ward.

episodes.title: Cloud Ledger
episodes.synopsis: Owen gives Hana billing records for diverted storms, then loses access to the control tower before he can copy its logs.

episodes.title: Heat Index
episodes.synopsis: Director Pell orders more rain north of Selden as southern hospitals struggle through a punishing heat wave.

episodes.title: Counterforecast
episodes.synopsis: Hana broadcasts a rival forecast to warn the south, risking her license when Pell publicly disputes her data.

episodes.title: Rain Debt
episodes.synopsis: Owen finds the array has stored enough moisture for a destructive release, leaving Hana one night to model a safer shutdown.

episodes.title: Open Sky
episodes.synopsis: At Selden's control tower, Hana must distribute the storm across the city while Pell tries to reserve the last clear corridor.

shows.title: Sunder Vale
shows.synopsis: In Sunder Vale, courier Ren Akio discovers that the bells guarding mountain villages are being silenced before each monster attack. He recruits apprentice bellmaker Kira and disgraced guardian Daigo to find who is selling the towers' tuning stones.

episodes.title: The Silent Bell
episodes.synopsis: Ren reaches Cedar Watch after its bell falls silent and races Kira to the tower before night creatures cross the ridge.

episodes.title: Copper Tongue
episodes.synopsis: Kira repairs Cedar Watch's clapper but finds its tuning stone removed, leaving Daigo to guard the village without a warning.

episodes.title: Courier's Mark
episodes.synopsis: Ren follows a forged delivery seal toward Flint Pass and learns someone used his route to move stolen stones.

episodes.title: Guardian Without Armor
episodes.synopsis: Daigo teaches Ren to fight at Flint Pass while Kira searches the abandoned forge for the bellmaker's ledger.

episodes.title: The Fifth Tower
episodes.synopsis: Kira finds an unlisted tower above Sunder Vale, and Ren climbs toward it before the next bell is struck mute.

episodes.title: Stone Seller
episodes.synopsis: Daigo recognizes the trader at the tower market, but arresting her would reveal his own role in the first theft.

episodes.title: Ridgefire
episodes.synopsis: Ren carries a warning through burning grass to Moon Hamlet while Kira tries to tune a cracked bell by ear.

episodes.title: Another Sound
episodes.synopsis: Kira tests a new alloy in Moon Hamlet, risking the town's last working tower to drive the creatures back.

episodes.title: Before the Chorus
episodes.synopsis: Daigo admits why he left the guardians as Ren prepares the valley towers for one coordinated signal.

episodes.title: All Bells Answer
episodes.synopsis: At Sunder Vale's summit, Ren delivers the final stone and Kira sounds a warning that exposes the true buyer.

shows.title: Apricot Lane
shows.synopsis: Student Emi Hoshino moves above her aunt's tiny stationery shop on Apricot Lane in the town of Mihara. She and shy neighbor Taku begin delivering forgotten letters around the district, discovering how much can change with a careful apology.

episodes.title: A Shop Above the Street
episodes.synopsis: Emi opens a mislabeled drawer in Fumi's Mihara shop and finds a letter that must reach its owner before the bakery closes.

episodes.title: Red Ink
episodes.synopsis: Taku helps Emi rewrite a damaged note on Apricot Lane, but his careful wording makes its apology sound like a bill.

episodes.title: The Rain Jar
episodes.synopsis: Fumi lends the pair a jar of old stamps when a storm traps them inside the shop with a worried customer.

episodes.title: Corner Bakery
episodes.synopsis: Emi delivers a recipe card to the Mihara baker and learns that its missing page belongs to his estranged brother.

episodes.title: Pencil Shavings
episodes.synopsis: Taku volunteers to run the shop for an hour, then has to find Emi before he accidentally gives away Fumi's account book.

episodes.title: Festival Notice
episodes.synopsis: Emi designs a handbill for Apricot Lane's festival, but a printing mistake puts the lantern walk on the wrong night.

episodes.title: Two Envelopes
episodes.synopsis: Fumi asks Emi to choose which of two unsent letters should be delivered, and Taku suggests asking their writers first.

episodes.title: The Blue Awning
episodes.synopsis: Taku waits under a blue awning in Mihara to return a postcard to the friend he has avoided all summer.

episodes.title: Late Delivery
episodes.synopsis: Emi loses a festival invitation on the last bus and retraces Apricot Lane before the recipient leaves town.

episodes.title: Open Tomorrow
episodes.synopsis: As Fumi closes the shop for a week, Emi and Taku build a letter box that lets their neighbors keep writing.

shows.title: Iron Heron
shows.synopsis: Cadet Aoi Kirisawa inherits an obsolete walking machine at the floating city of Senra after its pilot disappears. Mechanic Jiro believes the machine can defend the city from falling debris, but command wants to scrap it before anyone discovers what happened on the pilot's final sortie.

episodes.title: Hangar Seven
episodes.synopsis: Aoi enters Senra's sealed hangar and starts the Iron Heron just as debris alarms sound over the docks.

episodes.title: Rust Test
episodes.synopsis: Jiro replaces the Heron's seized joint, but Gaku demands a trial flight before the repair can be checked.

episodes.title: Falling Glass
episodes.synopsis: Aoi catches a shattered solar panel above Senra's school and finds a missing pilot's signal in its telemetry.

episodes.title: Manual Override
episodes.synopsis: Gaku locks down the hangar while Jiro searches the machine's old controls for evidence of the final sortie.

episodes.title: The Empty Seat
episodes.synopsis: Aoi follows a distress ping beyond Senra's safety line and sees the missing pilot's seat drifting alone.

episodes.title: Counterweight
episodes.synopsis: Jiro improvises a new balance system so Aoi can lift a collapsing bridge before commuters reach its center.

episodes.title: Command Channel
episodes.synopsis: Gaku admits he ordered the pilot into the debris field, forcing Aoi to decide whether she can trust his next warning.

episodes.title: Skyfall Diagram
episodes.synopsis: Aoi maps an incoming debris cluster from the Heron's cockpit and discovers Senra's shields have a blind side.

episodes.title: Against the Wind
episodes.synopsis: Jiro opens every service platform in Senra so Aoi can climb high enough to intercept the largest fragment.

episodes.title: Heron's Return
episodes.synopsis: Above Senra, Aoi risks the old machine to recover the missing pilot and keep the shield line intact.

shows.title: Blue Relay
shows.synopsis: Sprinter Mei Kanzaki joins the struggling relay team at Harbor North Academy, where captain Shun insists speed means nothing without a clean exchange. Their qualifying season tightens when teammate Riku's family move gives the four runners only ten weeks together.

episodes.title: Lane Four
episodes.synopsis: Mei outruns everyone at Harbor North tryouts but drops Shun's baton during the first exchange.

episodes.title: Ten Weeks
episodes.synopsis: Riku tells the team he is moving away, leaving Shun to plan a qualifying schedule around their limited practices.

episodes.title: The Passing Zone
episodes.synopsis: Shun marks the exchange zone on Harbor North's cracked track while Mei learns why an early start can erase her lead.

episodes.title: Rain Practice
episodes.synopsis: Mei and Riku practice handoffs in a downpour, but a slip leaves Riku afraid to run the inside lane.

episodes.title: Split Times
episodes.synopsis: The team loses a meet in Tsuru City, and Shun discovers their weakest split is his own.

episodes.title: One Shoe
episodes.synopsis: Mei lends Riku her spare spikes before a trial race, then has to compete in shoes that do not fit.

episodes.title: The Fourth Runner
episodes.synopsis: Shun asks a younger student to train as an alternate, making Riku fear the team is preparing to replace him.

episodes.title: Curve Work
episodes.synopsis: Mei changes her stride on Harbor North's bend and risks the speed that first won her a place.

episodes.title: At the Exchange
episodes.synopsis: A relay rival challenges Shun's starting call, forcing the captain to trust Mei's judgment at the district meet.

episodes.title: Blue Finish
episodes.synopsis: In the qualifying final, Mei takes the last baton from Riku knowing this may be their only race together.

shows.title: The Inkward Kingdom
shows.synopsis: Map student Nao Fukuda tumbles into the kingdom printed inside her unfinished atlas, where roads vanish whenever the margins are erased. With palace page Eren and a stubborn talking compass, she must redraw a route to the capital before the queen's isolated villages run out of supplies.

episodes.title: Into the Atlas
episodes.synopsis: Nao lands in the Inkward market and watches the only road home disappear beneath a spreading blank margin.

episodes.title: North Is Debatable
episodes.synopsis: Iri leads Nao and Eren through a forest drawn upside down, risking their supplies to reach an isolated mill.

episodes.title: The Erased Bridge
episodes.synopsis: Eren finds a bridge missing from the royal map, and Nao tries to sketch it before a grain caravan arrives.

episodes.title: Margin Notes
episodes.synopsis: Nao discovers her own handwriting in the atlas border, raising questions about who has been changing the kingdom.

episodes.title: A Town of Arrows
episodes.synopsis: Iri's needle spins in the town of Varo, where every sign points travelers away from the capital.

episodes.title: The Queen's Cartographer
episodes.synopsis: Eren introduces Nao to the royal mapmaker, who demands her pencil in exchange for access to the palace archive.

episodes.title: Blank Province
episodes.synopsis: Nao enters a province almost erased from the atlas and finds families marking their streets with colored thread.

episodes.title: Road in Red
episodes.synopsis: Eren carries the thread map to Varo while Nao redraws a road before its ink can dry in the rain.

episodes.title: The Fold
episodes.synopsis: Iri locates a crease hiding the final capital route, but flattening it could erase Nao's path back home.

episodes.title: Every Road Open
episodes.synopsis: At the palace, Nao offers the queen a living map that can be corrected by the villages it serves.

shows.title: Afterimage Station
shows.synopsis: At Minato Terminal, ticket clerk Yuna Mori sees passengers in photographs taken a day before they arrive. When one image shows her missing father on the final train, she and station cleaner Kosei investigate a platform omitted from every timetable.

episodes.title: One Day Early
episodes.synopsis: Yuna finds tomorrow's arrival photograph at Minato Terminal and recognizes a passenger who has been missing for years.

episodes.title: Ticket Stub
episodes.synopsis: Kosei retrieves a punched ticket from a locked booth, giving Yuna the number of a platform she cannot find.

episodes.title: The Last Train
episodes.synopsis: Suzu waits with Yuna at Minato's closing bell, but the photographed train passes without stopping.

episodes.title: No Platform Nine
episodes.synopsis: Yuna questions the terminal manager and discovers Platform Nine was removed from maps after an unexplained flood.

episodes.title: Blurred Face
episodes.synopsis: Kosei develops another photograph and sees Suzu fading from it, raising the cost of their search.

episodes.title: Under the Clock
episodes.synopsis: Suzu finds a service stair beneath Minato's clock, but opening it triggers an announcement in her father's voice.

episodes.title: Tomorrow's Crowd
episodes.synopsis: Yuna warns passengers away from a future crash while Kosei searches the hidden platform for its cause.

episodes.title: The Unclaimed Case
episodes.synopsis: Kosei opens a suitcase left on Platform Nine and finds records of people the station forgot to count.

episodes.title: Departure Board
episodes.synopsis: Suzu alters Minato's departure board to draw the missing travelers out before the final train arrives.

episodes.title: Clear Photograph
episodes.synopsis: Yuna reaches the hidden platform and must choose whether to follow her father or guide its passengers home.

shows.title: Letters at Dawn
shows.synopsis: Shy calligrapher Hina Sato exchanges unsigned notes with someone who keeps returning her lost brushes at the Kamizu arts school. She suspects classmate Jun, but their friendship grows complicated when he admits he has been writing to a different student all term.

episodes.title: Lost Brush
episodes.synopsis: Hina finds her best brush outside Kamizu's studio with a thank-you note she cannot place.

episodes.title: The Empty Envelope
episodes.synopsis: Jun offers to help Hina identify the writer, then hides an envelope addressed to Mika.

episodes.title: Spring Paper
episodes.synopsis: Mika asks Hina to letter a festival banner, and Hina recognizes the same careful ink strokes from her notes.

episodes.title: Wrong Desk
episodes.synopsis: Hina leaves a reply on Jun's desk at Kamizu, only to see another student collect it before class.

episodes.title: A Line Unsaid
episodes.synopsis: Jun confesses that he writes to Mika, forcing Hina to reconsider which part of their friendship she imagined.

episodes.title: Blue Ink Sunday
episodes.synopsis: Mika invites Hina to paint signs for the school fair and explains why she has been returning the brushes.

episodes.title: Folded Twice
episodes.synopsis: Hina starts an honest letter to Jun but folds it away when he asks her advice about Mika.

episodes.title: The Rain Exhibit
episodes.synopsis: A leak threatens Hina's calligraphy display, and Jun stays after school to save the work she thought he had never noticed.

episodes.title: Names on Paper
episodes.synopsis: Mika returns Hina's final lost brush at Kamizu and encourages her to sign the note she has kept hidden.

episodes.title: Morning Post
episodes.synopsis: At the arts school's sunrise exhibition, Hina gives Jun her signed letter and accepts that his answer may take time.

shows.title: Moonseed Garden
shows.synopsis: Apprentice gardener Fuyu inherits a greenhouse on Kiri Island where flowers open only under moonlight and reveal lost memories. Her friend Tama wants to sell the property to save the ferry service, but Fuyu believes one bloom contains the island's forgotten navigation route.

episodes.title: Night Blossom
episodes.synopsis: Fuyu opens Kiri Island's greenhouse and sees a flower replay the ferry's last safe crossing through heavy fog.

episodes.title: Glass Roof
episodes.synopsis: Tama repairs a shattered pane before the next moonrise, hoping Fuyu will reconsider his offer to buy the property.

episodes.title: The White Seed
episodes.synopsis: Aya identifies a rare seed in her mother's notes, but planting it could crowd out the greenhouse's oldest bloom.

episodes.title: Tide Table
episodes.synopsis: Fuyu compares a flower's memory with Kiri's tide records and finds an unmarked reef on the ferry route.

episodes.title: A Visitor by Boat
episodes.synopsis: Tama brings a mainland buyer to the greenhouse, forcing Fuyu to show why the plants matter to the islanders.

episodes.title: The Unopened Bud
episodes.synopsis: Aya tends a stubborn bud while a fog warning cancels the ferry's only supply run.

episodes.title: Old Lantern
episodes.synopsis: Fuyu follows a remembered lantern to Kiri's abandoned shore tower and finds a damaged navigation marker.

episodes.title: Petals at Low Tide
episodes.synopsis: Tama helps Fuyu retrieve the marker from a tidal cave before the incoming water seals it.

episodes.title: Moonless Night
episodes.synopsis: With no moon to open the flowers, Aya must reconstruct the safe channel from her mother's written observations.

episodes.title: The Garden Stays
episodes.synopsis: Fuyu presents the new ferry route at Kiri's harbor meeting and offers Tama a way to protect both boat and greenhouse.

shows.title: Signal Bloom
shows.synopsis: On the orbital farm Aster, technician Rei Nagata discovers that the crop lights are transmitting replies to messages sent from an abandoned Earth observatory. Pilot Kaoru wants to follow the signal, but the farm's oxygen harvest depends on keeping the lights exactly as they are.

episodes.title: Green Frequency
episodes.synopsis: Rei hears a coded answer in Aster's grow lamps and postpones their scheduled reset to preserve the message.

episodes.title: Oxygen Count
episodes.synopsis: Enzo warns Rei that the altered lights are reducing the harvest, leaving Kaoru one day to trace the source.

episodes.title: Old Observatory
episodes.synopsis: Kaoru locates the abandoned Earth observatory while Rei finds its last transmission embedded in a crop log.

episodes.title: The Seed Vault
episodes.synopsis: Rei protects Aster's seed vault from a power surge and discovers the reply carries planting instructions.

episodes.title: Ground Track
episodes.synopsis: Kaoru adjusts Aster's orbit to see the observatory, risking the station's narrow solar window.

episodes.title: Someone Listening
episodes.synopsis: Enzo intercepts a second signal from Earth and asks Rei why it names a worker who has not yet arrived.

episodes.title: Low Harvest
episodes.synopsis: Rei tests the transmitted seed pattern in a small tray as Aster's oxygen reserves begin to fall.

episodes.title: Descent Window
episodes.synopsis: Kaoru prepares an Earth descent to inspect the observatory, but Enzo threatens to disconnect the crop lights.

episodes.title: Living Circuit
episodes.synopsis: Rei finds that the new plants carry the signal without lamps, giving Aster a chance to restore its oxygen cycle.

episodes.title: First Reply
episodes.synopsis: At the Earth observatory, Kaoru discovers who sent the instructions while Rei decides what Aster should transmit back.

shows.title: Midnight Bento
shows.synopsis: Young cook Saki Ueno runs a food cart on the overnight train between Hoshi and Maru, where every stop brings a new passenger with an impossible order. Conductor Gen gives her one month to prove the cart can pay its way before the railway removes the kitchen car.

episodes.title: Car Seven
episodes.synopsis: Saki boards the Hoshi night train and burns her first meal just as Gen announces the kitchen's monthly review.

episodes.title: Pickled Sunrise
episodes.synopsis: Momo asks Saki to pack breakfast for a mountain survey crew, but the train reaches their stop before dawn.

episodes.title: No Rice Left
episodes.synopsis: Saki runs out of rice at Maru Station and bargains with a noodle vendor to feed passengers waiting through a delay.

episodes.title: The Sleeper's Order
episodes.synopsis: Gen receives a dinner request from a passenger who will not wake, leaving Saki to learn what the traveler actually needs.

episodes.title: Platform Soup
episodes.synopsis: Momo serves hot soup on a cold platform while Saki searches for a missing ingredient before the train departs.

episodes.title: Three Empty Boxes
episodes.synopsis: Saki finds three returned bento boxes at Hoshi and follows their notes to a family traveling in separate cars.

episodes.title: Kitchen Inspection
episodes.synopsis: Gen inspects Car Seven after a complaint, and Saki must prove her improvised stove is safe enough to keep.

episodes.title: Tunnel Delay
episodes.synopsis: A stalled train traps Saki between stations with limited food and more hungry passengers than she planned for.

episodes.title: Last Order
episodes.synopsis: Momo helps Saki calculate the cart's earnings before Gen's review, revealing one unpaid meal that could decide its fate.

episodes.title: Breakfast Arrival
episodes.synopsis: At Maru's morning platform, Saki serves the railway board a meal made from the passengers' saved ingredients.

shows.title: Paper Tide
shows.synopsis: In Nami Port, apprentice printer Chiyo discovers folded paper boats that arrive carrying tomorrow's tide warnings. Harbor diver Haru follows their trail beneath the old press, where a flooded room holds the names of sailors missing from the town's official records.

episodes.title: A Boat at Dawn
episodes.synopsis: Chiyo catches a paper boat outside the Nami print shop and warns Haru of a tide surge before the docks open.

episodes.title: Ink That Holds
episodes.synopsis: Nene tests the boat's strange ink while Chiyo searches the shop for the paper stock used to fold it.

episodes.title: Below the Press
episodes.synopsis: Haru dives under Nami's old press and finds a door that opens only when the tide is highest.

episodes.title: Missing Names
episodes.synopsis: Chiyo reads sailors' names on a damp ledger, then discovers one belongs to a man working at the harbor today.

episodes.title: The Wrong Tide
episodes.synopsis: A paper warning predicts low water at Nami, but Haru sees the harbor rising and suspects someone changed the message.

episodes.title: Dry Room
episodes.synopsis: Nene reveals an unused print room above the flood line, where Chiyo finds evidence of a second boat maker.

episodes.title: Folded Current
episodes.synopsis: Haru follows a flotilla into the old channel and risks being trapped when the forecasted tide turns early.

episodes.title: Names in Red
episodes.synopsis: Chiyo prints the lost sailors' names across Nami Port, forcing the harbor council to acknowledge the missing records.

episodes.title: Before the Surge
episodes.synopsis: Nene deciphers one final boat, giving Haru minutes to clear the waterfront before a dangerous current arrives.

episodes.title: The Unfolding
episodes.synopsis: Chiyo opens the flooded ledger beneath the press and learns who has been sending warnings through the paper tide.

shows.title: Copper Comet
shows.synopsis: Mechanic Sora Imai builds a small rescue craft from obsolete copper engines in the asteroid settlement of Toma. When a mining convoy disappears beyond the beacon field, she and navigator Kenji must choose between a forbidden search and waiting for officials who insist the route is empty.

episodes.title: Scrap Engine
episodes.synopsis: Sora starts her copper craft in Toma's salvage yard as the convoy's distress signal flickers beyond the beacons.

episodes.title: Forbidden Heading
episodes.synopsis: Kenji plots a rescue route through uncharted rock, forcing Sora to launch before Captain Isamu closes the dock.

episodes.title: Beacon Four
episodes.synopsis: The crew reaches a dark beacon and finds the convoy's cargo tag attached to an empty escape pod.

episodes.title: Copper Heat
episodes.synopsis: Sora cools an overheating engine with spare water, reducing their life support margin near the asteroid belt.

episodes.title: The Hidden Vein
episodes.synopsis: Kenji discovers a secret mining tunnel, but entering it will put their small craft beyond Toma's radio range.

episodes.title: No Return Ping
episodes.synopsis: Isamu follows Sora's last coordinates and finds evidence that the convoy deliberately disabled its own beacon.

episodes.title: Ore Ghosts
episodes.synopsis: Sora boards a silent hauler and hears trapped miners calling through the hull before its power fails.

episodes.title: Hard Burn
episodes.synopsis: Kenji guides the rescued crew around a collapsing rock face while Sora pushes the copper engine past its tested limit.

episodes.title: Home Signal
episodes.synopsis: Isamu reopens Toma's beacon field, but a mining company order threatens to turn the rescue craft back.

episodes.title: Comet Trail
episodes.synopsis: Sora brings the miners into Toma and releases their navigation log before the convoy's disappearance can be buried.

audiobooks.title: Pride and Prejudice
audiobooks.author: Jane Austen
audiobooks.authorBio: Jane Austen turned the manners and marriage markets of Regency England into comedy with a sharp moral eye. Her novels were published between 1811 and 1817.
audiobooks.synopsis: At Longbourn, Elizabeth Bennet dismisses the reserved Mr. Darcy after a disastrous first meeting. As her sisters' prospects shift and an old accusation resurfaces, Elizabeth must reconsider what pride has concealed from them both.

audiobooks.title: Frankenstein
audiobooks.author: Mary Shelley
audiobooks.authorBio: Mary Shelley wrote Frankenstein while still a teenager and later built a career as a novelist and editor. Her fiction often tests the cost of ambition against human responsibility.
audiobooks.synopsis: Scientist Victor Frankenstein assembles a living being in Ingolstadt, then abandons him in terror. Rejected by every family he approaches, the creature pursues his maker across Europe and demands an answer for his loneliness.

audiobooks.title: Dracula
audiobooks.author: Bram Stoker
audiobooks.authorBio: Bram Stoker managed a London theater while writing novels and short fiction. His best-known book gathers letters, diaries, and newspaper reports into a single mounting threat.
audiobooks.synopsis: Solicitor Jonathan Harker arrives at a Transylvanian castle whose host never seems to eat and casts no reflection. Once Count Dracula reaches England, Mina Murray and a small circle of friends trace a series of strange illnesses back to his voyage.

audiobooks.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
audiobooks.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
audiobooks.authorBio: Arthur Conan Doyle was a Scottish physician whose detective stories made close observation into a form of drama. He also wrote historical novels, adventure fiction, and public essays.
audiobooks.synopsis: From a vanished bridegroom to a royal photograph, twelve cases pull Dr. Watson back into Holmes's London rooms. Each puzzle hinges on an overlooked detail that places a client's reputation, livelihood, or life in danger.

audiobooks.title: Moby-Dick
audiobooks.author: Herman Melville
audiobooks.authorBio: Herman Melville drew on years at sea for novels that range from adventure to philosophical inquiry. Moby-Dick found its broad readership long after its original publication.
audiobooks.synopsis: Ishmael signs aboard the Pequod in Nantucket, expecting a whaling voyage under Captain Ahab. He soon learns the captain means to chase the white whale that took his leg, no matter what the hunt costs the crew.

audiobooks.title: The Time Machine
audiobooks.author: H. G. Wells
audiobooks.authorBio: H. G. Wells used speculative fiction to examine class, power, and scientific change. His early novels helped establish the modern language of science fiction.
audiobooks.synopsis: A London inventor reaches the year 802,701 and befriends Weena, a woman among the carefree Eloi. When the subterranean Morlocks steal his machine, he must descend beneath their ruined world to recover his only route home.

chapters.title: The Trap of the White Sphinx

audiobooks.title: Little Women
audiobooks.author: Louisa May Alcott
audiobooks.authorBio: Louisa May Alcott supported her family through writing and nursing before the March sisters made her famous. Her stories draw on the work and ambitions of women in her own household.
audiobooks.synopsis: With their father away at war, Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy March find ways to grow up without losing one another. In Concord, small acts of generosity and painful mistakes test each sister's idea of the life she wants.

audiobooks.title: The Great Gatsby
audiobooks.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
audiobooks.authorBio: F. Scott Fitzgerald chronicled wealth and aspiration in American fiction of the 1920s. His precise, restless prose gave the Jazz Age one of its enduring portraits.
audiobooks.synopsis: Nick Carraway rents a modest Long Island house beside Jay Gatsby's glittering estate. Gatsby's elaborate parties conceal a plan to reclaim Daisy Buchanan, and Nick watches that dream collide with money, marriage, and a fatal drive.

audiobooks.title: A Christmas Carol
audiobooks.author: Charles Dickens
audiobooks.authorBio: Charles Dickens published serial fiction that brought crowded Victorian streets and social inequality to a vast audience. He also campaigned for children's welfare and better public institutions.
audiobooks.synopsis: On Christmas Eve in London, the miser Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by his dead business partner, who warns that three spirits will follow. Their journeys through memory, present hardship, and a lonely future give him one night to change course.

audiobooks.title: Treasure Island
audiobooks.author: Robert Louis Stevenson
audiobooks.authorBio: Robert Louis Stevenson wrote adventure stories, essays, and travel books while living across Britain, Europe, and the Pacific. His fiction often lets a young narrator discover adult danger firsthand.
audiobooks.synopsis: Young Jim Hawkins finds a map in a dead sailor's chest at the Admiral Benbow Inn. A voyage to recover the buried treasure turns perilous when Jim overhears the ship's cook, Long John Silver, planning a mutiny.

audiobooks.title: Jane Eyre
audiobooks.author: Charlotte Brontë
audiobooks.authorBio: Charlotte Brontë published poetry and fiction under the name Currer Bell. Her novels joined intense inner life to questions of work, independence, and social rank.
audiobooks.synopsis: After a harsh childhood at Gateshead and Lowood, Jane Eyre becomes a governess at Thornfield Hall. Her growing bond with Edward Rochester is threatened by strange laughter and a hidden secret that could cost Jane her hard-won independence.

audiobooks.title: The Call of the Wild
audiobooks.author: Jack London
audiobooks.authorBio: Jack London drew on his travels and manual labor for stories of survival and social conflict. His Alaska fiction remains closely tied to the Klondike Gold Rush.
audiobooks.synopsis: Stolen from a comfortable California home, Buck is sold into sled work in the Yukon. As brutal handlers and rival dogs reshape his life, his attachment to prospector John Thornton pulls against an older instinct for the forest.

audiobooks.title: The Tide Clerk
audiobooks.author: Mara Ellison
audiobooks.authorBio: Mara Ellison grew up around working harbors and writes mysteries about the records people leave behind. The Tide Clerk is her first novel.
audiobooks.synopsis: When a ledger vanishes from Bellwether's harbor office, clerk Ada Voss finds its last entry names a ferry passenger who died twenty years earlier. Her search through tide tables exposes a smuggling route that still carries people at night.

audiobooks.title: The Glass Buoy
audiobooks.author: Mara Ellison
audiobooks.authorBio: For her second Bellwether mystery, Mara Ellison drew on accounts of salvage crews and disputed wrecks. She writes from a small coastal town.
audiobooks.synopsis: A diver brings Ada Voss a sealed buoy recovered outside Bellwether, with a fresh note inside from a captain presumed lost at sea. Ada follows the buoy's drift back to a private salvage crew whose next job could erase the harbor's only witness.

audiobooks.title: Orbit of Ashes
audiobooks.author: Keon Park
audiobooks.authorBio: Keon Park writes near-future fiction about ordinary workers inside extraordinary machines. He studied mechanical engineering before turning to novels.
audiobooks.synopsis: After an orbital refinery burns, mechanic Leda Saye survives in a maintenance pod with enough air for two days. Her distress call reaches a rescue ship, but its crew has orders to destroy the refinery's flight recorder before she can hand it over.

audiobooks.title: The Silent Apogee
audiobooks.author: Keon Park
audiobooks.authorBio: Keon Park returns to orbital infrastructure in his second Cinder Orbit novel. His stories follow technicians forced to question the missions they maintain.
audiobooks.synopsis: Leda Saye is hired to inspect a weather station that has gone dark above the Indian Ocean. Its last transmission includes a voice message from her dead brother, drawing her into a dispute over who controls the planet's storm forecasts.

audiobooks.title: Small Hours at Mercy Street
audiobooks.author: Nina Calder
audiobooks.authorBio: Nina Calder writes about family obligations and the places where people rebuild their routines. Her fiction has appeared in independent literary magazines.
audiobooks.synopsis: After her mother's stroke, June Mercer takes over the overnight shift at a laundromat in Pittsburgh. The regular customers know pieces of her mother's past that June never heard, and their stories force her to reconsider a long-avoided move.

audiobooks.title: Maps for the Missing
audiobooks.author: Avery Chen
audiobooks.authorBio: Avery Chen writes investigative thrillers with an eye for civic systems and overlooked neighborhoods. Chen lives in the Pacific Northwest.
audiobooks.synopsis: Cartographer Ellis Ward notices that three city evacuation maps omit the same apartment block in Tacoma. Days before a coastal drill, a tenant disappears there, and Ellis must find who altered the maps before the building is sealed.

audiobooks.title: When the Orchards Froze
audiobooks.author: Elise Varga
audiobooks.authorBio: Elise Varga researches rural labor and food history. Her narrative histories connect family archives with changes in land and industry.
audiobooks.synopsis: In 1917, an early freeze devastated apple growers around Brackenford. Varga follows Nora and Ellis Vale through farm ledgers and family diaries as they organize credit, storage, and a shared rail shipment to survive the winter.

audiobooks.title: An Atlas of Rain
audiobooks.author: Samira Dey
audiobooks.authorBio: Samira Dey writes personal essays about migration, memory, and the work of making a home. Her first book grew out of notebooks kept across three cities.
audiobooks.synopsis: From monsoon afternoons in Kolkata to wet bus stops in Seattle, Samira Dey charts the weather that marked her family's moves. A box of damaged photographs prompts her to revisit each address and ask what her parents chose to leave unsaid.

audiobooks.title: The Brass Garden
audiobooks.author: Liora Fen
audiobooks.authorBio: Liora Fen writes fantasy shaped by craft, apprenticeship, and difficult promises. She lives near a botanical garden and collects broken clocks.
audiobooks.synopsis: Apprentice gardener Nera finds metal roots growing beneath the royal greenhouse in Valenne. When the plants begin copying people's voices, she must identify who planted them before the queen's treaty feast becomes a trap.

audiobooks.title: Good Enough Tomorrow
audiobooks.author: Leah Sorrel
audiobooks.authorBio: Leah Sorrel is a counselor and workshop leader who studies how people sustain small changes. She writes in practical exercises drawn from everyday setbacks.
audiobooks.synopsis: In Bellwick, night-shift nurse Tessa Reed tries to keep healthy habits through a changing schedule. Sorrel uses Tessa's setbacks alongside a new parent's and a returning student's to show how small restarts can keep one missed task from becoming a verdict.

audiobooks.title: The Bridge Keeper
audiobooks.author: Owen Rusk
audiobooks.authorBio: Owen Rusk writes historical fiction centered on workers whose decisions change a community. His novels favor tools, trades, and precise local detail.
audiobooks.synopsis: During the spring flood of 1936, bridge keeper Thomas Bell is ordered to keep a mill road open outside Marlowe. A school bus stalls on the span, leaving Thomas to choose between his employer's orders and the families waiting downstream.

audiobooks.title: Birds Over Briar Lake
audiobooks.author: Ruth Haldane
audiobooks.authorBio: Ruth Haldane is a naturalist whose field writing follows the people who protect ordinary habitats. She has spent many springs counting wetland birds.
audiobooks.synopsis: At Briar Lake, volunteers record the return of marsh birds while a proposed road threatens the reed beds. Haldane follows one breeding season through dawn counts, local hearings, and the patient work of restoring a shoreline.

audiobooks.title: Every Door in June
audiobooks.author: Petra Moss
audiobooks.authorBio: Petra Moss writes romantic comedies about people who make lists and then fall off them. Her work is set in walkable, slightly chaotic cities.
audiobooks.synopsis: Apartment manager Bea Linden has one month to fix a condemned stairwell in Providence, but the building's carpenter is the ex who once left her mid-renovation. Every repair reveals another secret in the walls, and their residents start taking bets on which problem will be solved first.

audiobooks.title: The Quiet Archive
audiobooks.author: Ivo Serrano
audiobooks.authorBio: Ivo Serrano writes suspense about institutions and the people asked to trust them. He previously worked as a records conservator.
audiobooks.synopsis: An archivist in Santa Fe receives a reel labeled with tomorrow's date and the sound of a woman confessing to a fire that has not happened. He identifies her as a museum guard and races to locate the recording's source before someone stages the blaze.

audiobooks.title: The Salt Road Kitchen
audiobooks.author: Fern Bellamy
audiobooks.authorBio: Fern Bellamy writes food memoir rooted in family recipes and working kitchens. She learned to cook beside her aunt at a seaside guesthouse.
audiobooks.synopsis: When Fern inherits her aunt's shuttered guesthouse in Northumberland, she finds a recipe book annotated with the names of former visitors. Reopening the kitchen one supper at a time brings back people whose stories alter what she remembers about her childhood summers.

chapters.title: What Was Left in the Pantry

audiobooks.title: The City Beneath Tuesday
audiobooks.author: Dalia Wren
audiobooks.authorBio: Dalia Wren builds speculative cities around familiar civic problems and improbable solutions. She writes from a small studio above a train station.
audiobooks.synopsis: Every Tuesday, a second city appears below the subway platforms of Holloway, and courier Niko Vale delivers messages between its residents and those above. When the stairs fail to disappear on Wednesday, both cities face a flood from a river neither remembers building.

music.name: Lantern Parade
music.bio: Lantern Parade builds guitar songs around small domestic details and large, open choruses. Their records favor ringing strings, unhurried drums, and voices that sound close to the room.

music.name: Mira Solace
music.bio: Mira Solace writes bright melodies with lyrics that leave room for doubt. Her voice moves from intimate verses to brass-backed refrains without losing its conversational edge.

music.name: Glass Harbor
music.bio: Glass Harbor layers pulse-driven electronics beneath field recordings and soft piano figures. The duo's patient arrangements turn transit noise and shoreline weather into rhythm.

music.name: August Vale Trio
music.bio: Pianist August Vale leads a trio that leaves generous space between its phrases. Their late-night sets favor sly swing, brushed drums, and bass lines that can turn a ballad inside out.

music.name: Tarnished Crown
music.bio: Tarnished Crown pairs dense riffs with stories about ruined kingdoms and the people inside them. The quartet's drummer drives the songs forward while the guitars move between menace and melody.

music.name: Cedar Motel
music.bio: Cedar Motel writes road songs about ordinary work and the cost of going home. Pedal steel, fiddle, and close harmonies keep their stories grounded even when the highways stretch out.

music.name: Lumen Fields
music.bio: Lumen Fields records slow, luminous pieces with bowed strings and processed room tone. The music asks for attention without demanding it, moving in quiet increments toward a clear horizon.

music.name: The North Inlet
music.bio: The North Inlet mixes fiddle, guitar, and three voices shaped by coastal storytelling. Their songs follow ferries, working families, and weather with warmth and a little dry humor.

music.name: Asha Venn
music.bio: Asha Venn sings precise, intimate songs over warm bass and spare percussion. Her arrangements leave silence around a lyric until a harmony arrives at exactly the right moment.

music.name: Mosaic Ledger
music.bio: Mosaic Ledger turns block-by-block observation into tightly written verses. Dusty keys, handclaps, and found percussion make the productions feel like a city recorded from its sidewalks.

music.name: Alba Cordero
music.bio: Alba Cordero sets nimble Spanish lyrics against hand percussion and bright guitar. She moves between dance-floor momentum and reflective songs without changing her vivid sense of place.

music.name: Iona Merrow
music.bio: Composer and pianist Iona Merrow writes chamber works with clear melodic lines and restless inner voices. Her recordings often put small ensembles in resonant, unadorned rooms.

tracks.title: I. Allegro con moto, Rain Quartet

music.name: Kite Assembly
music.bio: Kite Assembly makes taut guitar pop from hurried conversations and missed trains. The band's quick changes of tempo give even its quietest songs a sense of pursuit.

music.name: Velvet Islet
music.bio: Velvet Islet came together around a neighborhood rehearsal room and a shared love of tight horn lines. Their harmony-led soul has the easy confidence of players listening closely to one another.

music.name: Sable Circuit
music.bio: Sable Circuit makes club tracks from lean percussion and cold, clean synths. A subtle melodic turn often waits beneath the beat until the room has settled into it.

music.name: Juniper Frame
music.bio: Juniper Frame records fingerpicked folk songs about letters, gardens, and the long work of forgiveness. A low, dry vocal delivery keeps the arrangements close to the page.

music.name: Night Quarry
music.bio: Night Quarry uses shifting meters and heavy, patient riffs to tell stories of extraction and collapse. Their songs make industrial landscapes feel immense and painfully human.

music.name: Calla Roux
music.bio: Calla Roux writes polished pop that notices the awkward details between dramatic moments. Bright keyboards and crisp drums make room for hooks that arrive early and linger.

music.name: Blue Hour Quartet
music.bio: Blue Hour Quartet grew from after-hours sessions among four conservatory friends. Their recordings balance relaxed swing with alert, playful exchanges between saxophone and piano.

music.name: Ember Finch
music.bio: Ember Finch composes story-led instrumental music for imagined films and stage pieces. Woodwinds and low strings often carry the scene before percussion shifts its perspective.

music.name: Wren Duarte
music.bio: Wren Duarte writes plainspoken country songs with sharp comic turns. Her fiddle player and upright bassist give the stories a nimble lift without crowding the words.

music.name: Hollow Atlas
music.bio: Hollow Atlas writes reflective verses over clipped samples and spacious bass. He draws maps of changing neighborhoods through the voices and details people usually pass by.

music.name: Port Sun
music.bio: Port Sun brings hand drums and syncopated guitar into a restless electronic setting. Their songs feel built for a late waterfront walk that turns into a crowded dance floor.

music.name: Silas Ferre
music.bio: Silas Ferre writes low-key R&B built around falsetto hooks and live bass. His songs linger on the things people say while trying to leave a room gracefully.

al-lantern-parade-familiar-roads::Porchl.line: The porchlight flickered twice at ten
You said the rain was coming in
I moved the chairs away from the screen
And watched the street turn silver green
Leave one light on for the way back home
Leave one light on when the roads are gone
The storm can have the maple tree

Your coffee cooled beside the door
The weather radio asked for more
A neighbor knocked with muddy shoes
We made some space and shared the news
Leave one light on for the way back home
Leave one light on when the roads are gone
Across the dark a window shone
Then another answered from down the road
At morning's edge the rain let go
We counted every roof we know
Leave one light on for the way back home
And let the waking neighborhood glow

al-mira-solace-paper-hearts::Good in the.line: You call me brave when the lights are low

al-tarnished-crown-iron-vigil::The Broke.line: The outer wall gave way at dawn

Hold fast, hold fast, the bridge is narrow
Hold fast until the horns are still

al-the-north-inlet-soundings::Keeper of.line: Old Mara climbs the headland stairs

She checks the wick, she cleans the glass

Keep the light where the channel bends
Keep it burning for our friends
Out past the shoals and through the spray
There's still a lantern marking the way
A gale blew hard on Thursday night
The harbor vanished out of sight
Her grandson carried oil uphill

Keep the light where the channel bends
Keep it burning for our friends
A small boat answered through the foam
One steady flash to guide it home
At dawn the kettle started singing
Wet boots lined the kitchen floor
Mara said the lamp was simple
Then went to fill it once more

al-mosaic-ledger-common-ground::No Small.line: Mrs. Bell put a jar on the counter

First kid dropped in three bent pennies
Next came a note from old Miss Jenny
No small change on this side of town
Every coin makes a little sound
Stack them high till the glass comes round
No small change on this side of town
Rico fixed the frame on Friday
Brought his tools on the late train highway
Told us how his dad once worked here
Bought him soup when the rent was unclear
No small change on this side of town
Every coin makes a little sound
Stack them high till the glass comes round
No small change on this side of town
Now you can see the corner in the morning
Bread in rows and the buses forming
She kept that jar beside the till
For whatever the next cold season will

al-alba-cordero-patio-adentro::La Silla.line: Queda una silla roja junto al balcón
La pintó mi madre con una canción
Lleva tres veranos mirando pasar
A los que se marchan hacia el mar
Ven, toma asiento, que empieza el calor
Trae tus historias y un poco de sol
La silla roja conoce tu voz
Y guarda un lugar para los dos
Hoy llegó mi hermano con pan y café
Habló del camino que quiere emprender
No le pedí promesas al partir
Le di la llave para volver aquí
Ven, toma asiento, que empieza el calor

La silla roja conoce tu voz

Sonó una guitarra desde otro balcón
